		self.is_able_to_process = false
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'resume_npc_logic' then
		self.is_able_to_process = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.beth_quest_key then
		local labor_1 = get_character('labor_1')
		local labor_2 = get_character('labor_2')

		if (self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 ) then
			labor_1.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
			labor_2.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		end

		self.is_able_to_process = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.beth_quest_key then
		local labor_1 = get_character('labor_1')
		local labor_2 = get_character('labor_2')

		if (self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 ) then
			labor_1.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
			labor_2.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
		end

		self.is_able_to_process = true
	end
end

function local_class:fade_routine(fo, alpha, active_state)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, alpha, self.fade_duration)
	wait_for_sec(self.fade_duration)

	character_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state)
end


function local_class:on_activate_exit_interactable_event(e)
	local fo = get_field_object('beth_roof_exit')
	if fo == nil then return end

	if e.IsActive then
		fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	else
		fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end
end

	self.current_notoriety_num = 'current_notoriety_num'

	self.current_notoriety_lv = 'current_notoriety_lv'

	-- 퀘스트 커스텀 변수, 키
	self.save_lv_custom_key = 'notoriety_lv'
	self.save_num_custom_key = 'notoriety_num'

end

function local_class:load_resource()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()

end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'DemonWorldWorstCriminalSection1')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'DemonWorldWorstCriminalPostSection')
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_police_erina()) then

		if self.quest_progress == nil then
			return
		end

		self.defeat_erina = 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(quest_util.set_custom_state,
				self.quest_progress, self.save_defeat_erina, 1))
	end
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
	)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	-- 저장된 변수 가져옴
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		self.notoriety_lv = self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.save_lv_custom_key)
		self.notoriety_num = self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.save_num_custom_key)
		self.defeat_erina = self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.save_defeat_erina)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- 혹시 모르니 막음...
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(216)
	if ( main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.InnerProgress < 5 ) then return end

		-- 악명 레벨 변경
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.current_notoriety_lv then
		-- 올라간 경우에 저장
		local cur_lv = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))

		if self.notoriety_lv < cur_lv then
			self.notoriety_lv = cur_lv
		end

		if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(quest_util.set_custom_state,
					self.quest_progress, self.save_lv_custom_key, self.notoriety_lv))
		end
	-- 악명 점수 변경
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.current_notoriety_num then
		-- 올라간 경우에 저장
		local cur_num = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))

		if self.notoriety_num < cur_num then
			self.notoriety_num = cur_num
		end
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(quest_util.set_custom_state,
					self.quest_progress, self.save_num_custom_key, self.notoriety_num))
		end
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.Grade == -1 then
			self.current_section:set_quest_icon()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_id = nil
	self.sections = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end

		Type = controller @
		QuestName = DesertAnimalCrossing @
		Comment = 동물의 숲 패러디 서브 퀘스트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)

	-- 원래 파티 리더를 저장
	self.saved_party_leader = nil

	self.bee_states = {
		patrol = 1,
		stung = 2
	}

	self.state_of_bees = {}

	self.bee_update_routines = {}
end


function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointGuardDetectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GuildCastleSitEvent))

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.bee_states = nil
	self.state_of_bees = nil
	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.WaypointGuardDetectEvent) then
		local event_playing = e.Target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState ~= nil and
				lua_helper.type_compare(e.Target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState)
		if not event_playing then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.stung_by_bee, self, e.Sender)
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_field_object('oasis_in')) or type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_field_object('oasis_out')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_oasis_tent, self, e.Target.Name)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GuildCastleSitEvent) then
		if e.IsSittingOn then
			local kk = get_character('kk')
			local dir = vector_util.to_direction(kk.Position - user_party.Leader.Position)
			user_party.Leader:SetLockedDirection(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(dir, 11));
			local sc = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterControllerSitState.Create(user_party.Leader, e.Chair, nil))
			message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, sc)
		else
			user_party.Leader:RemoveLockedDirection(user_party.Leader)
			local is_sitting = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState ~= nil and
					lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerSitState)
			if is_sitting == true then
				user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:FinishSitState()
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'DesertAnimalCrossingPreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'DesertAnimalCrossingSection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'DesertAnimalCrossingSection2'),
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'DesertAnimalCrossingPostSection')
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	self:load_switch_leader()

	if self.starting_grade ~= -1 and not stage_progress:HasStarPiece('animal_crossing_starpiece') then
		local star_piece = get_field_object('animal_crossing_starpiece')
		star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false
	end

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointGuardDetectEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GuildCastleSitEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 퀘스트를 완료하지않았다면 벌들의 애니메이션을 전부 나는것으로 바꾸어준다.
	if self.quest_progres == nil or not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local bee = get_character('desert_bee_' .. i)
			if bee ~= nil then
				bee:SetAnimation('fly', true)
			end
		end
	end

	self:section_setting()
end

function local_class:section_setting()
	if self.quest_progress == nil then return end

	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self:quest_clear_setting()
	else
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
			local sheep = get_character('sheep')
			local duck = get_character('duck')

			sheep.Position = get_field_object('place_table_1').Position + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.45
			sheep.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

			duck.Position = get_field_object('place_table_2').Position + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.45
			duck.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
			-- 부탁해요!
			local meerkat_kid = get_character('meerkat_kid')
			meerkat_kid.Interactable.Talk = 'desert_animal_crossing_s1_7'

			-- 벌들에게 공격당해 쓰러진 주민들의 구출을 부탁해. 미어!
			local meerkat = get_character('meerkat')
			meerkat.Interactable.Talk = 'desert_animal_crossing_s1_8'
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

function local_class:stung_by_bee(bee)
	local animals = { get_character('sheep'), get_character('duck') }
	local leader_holdup_animal = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) and
			table_util.contain_value(animals, user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)

	-- 동물을 구조하고있었다면 동물을 즉시 내려놓는다
	local held_animal
	if leader_holdup_animal then
		held_animal = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		character_util.release_hold_object(user_party.Leader, held_animal)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, bee)
	user_party.Leader.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(user_party.Leader.Direction)
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_bee_01')
	character_util.stop(bee)
	character_util.look_at(bee, user_party.Leader)
	bee:SetEmotion('mad', true)
	bee:SetAnimation('attack', true)
	character_util.move_to_async(bee, user_party.Leader.Position, nil, 6.5)

	local bee_move = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.bee_move_around_player, self, bee, 1.95))

	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('damaged', true)

	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')
	user_party.Leader.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(user_party.Leader.Direction)
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('frustration', false)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	stop_coroutine(bee_move)
	coroutine.yield()

	if leader_holdup_animal then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(held_animal, get_character('duck')) then
			held_animal.Position = vector(58, 1, -14.5)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(held_animal, get_character('sheep')) then
			held_animal.Position = vector(62, 0, -9.5)
		end
	end

	local reset_marker = field:GetMarker(bee.Name .. '_reset')
	party_util.position_party(reset_marker.position, reset_marker.direction)
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	-- 벌 상태 초기화
	bee:RemoveEmotion()
	bee:SetAnimation('fly', true)
	message_system:SendSync(bee.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

function local_class:bee_move_around_player(bee, stung_time)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = bee.Position
	while time_passed < stung_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local angle = 2 * unity_class.mathf.PI * unity_class.random.value
		local dir = vector(unity_class.mathf.Cos(angle), 0, unity_class.mathf.Sin(angle))

		bee.Position = start_pos + dir * 0.5

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:interact_to_oasis_tent(marker_name)
	local marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	-- 메인퀘스트를 클리어하지 않았다면 마빈과 스폰지밥의 처리를 해준다.
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(90)
	if main_quest ~= nil and not main_quest.IsComplete then
		if marker_name == 'oasis_in' then
			local marvin = get_character('marvin')
			character_util.convert_to_npc(marvin)

			local sponge_bob = get_character('sponge_bob')
			character_util.stop(sponge_bob)

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local asset_bundle_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.AssetName.assetBundleName
	local asset_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.AssetName.assetName
	local skin_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.SkinName

	local holder_for_leader = get_character(self.switch_leader_name)

	-- 이전 파티 리더 저장
	self.saved_party_leader = user_party_leader

	if user_party_leader.Costume == nil then
		holder_for_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.SpriteAssetName =
		user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.CharacterSpec.SpriteAssetName
	else
		holder_for_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.SpriteAssetName =
		user_party_leader.Costume.CostumeSpec.AssetName
	end

	holder_for_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CharacterName =
	user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.CharacterSpec.CharacterName

	holder_for_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed =
	user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed

	holder_for_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualDashSpeed =
	user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualDashSpeed

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, res_holder,
			asset_bundle_name, asset_name, function(prefab)
				local go = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)

				if spine_controller ~= nil then
					holder_for_leader.SpineController:SwitchSpineController(spine_controller)
				else
					CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(go)
				end
			end)

	-- 스킨 설정

		holder_for_leader.SpineController.SkinName = skin_name
	end

	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	self.request_stage_name = 'steampunk_1_3'
	self.unlock_stage_name = 'substage_9_1'

	self.fade_color = unity_color({ 71 / 255.0, 200 / 255.0, 62 / 255.0, 1 })
	self.drop_items = {}
	self.illusion_monsters = {}
	self.illusion_items = {
		'cwp_plitvice_epic',
		'cwp_admiral_epic',
		'cwp_villainredhood_epic',
		'cwp_eugene_epic',
		'cwp_uptowngirl_epic',
		'cwp_idolcaptain_epic',
		'cwp_flowergirl_epic'
	}

	self.illusion_progress = {
		none = 1,
		did_drug = 2
	}
	self.current_illusion_progress = self.illusion_progress.none

	self.illusion_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self ,typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_fo_destroyed_event')

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'DrugDealerPreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'DrugDealerSection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'DrugDealerSection2'),
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if stage.Name == self.unlock_stage_name then
		local addicts = {
			get_character('down_addict_1'),
			get_character('down_addict_2'),
			get_character('down_addict_3'),
			get_character('down_addict_4'),
			get_character('down_addict_5'),
			get_character('down_addict_6'),
			get_character('down_addict_7'),
			get_character('down_addict_8'),
			get_character('battle_addict_1'),
			get_character('battle_addict_2'),
			get_character('battle_addict_3'),
			get_character('battle_addict_4'),
			get_character('battle_addict_4'),
		}
		for _, addict in ipairs(addicts) do
			addict.SpineController:AddColor('addict', unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 0)
			--if string.match(addict.Name, 'down') then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(addict, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			--end
		end

		for i = 1, 20 do
			table.insert(self.illusion_monsters, get_character('illusion_monster_' .. i))
		end
	end

	self:setting_section()
end

function local_class:setting_section()
	if stage.Name == self.request_stage_name then
		local addicts = { get_character('drug_addict_1'), get_character('drug_addict_2'), get_character('drug_addict_3'), }
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
			local black = get_character('black')
			black.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

			for _, addict in ipairs(addicts) do
				addict.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		else
			for _, addict in ipairs(addicts) do
				addict.SpineController:AddColor('addict', unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 0)
				field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(addict, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.unlock_stage_name then
		if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('block_return_door'))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('shortcut_door'))

			local cauldron = get_field_object('cauldron')
			cauldron.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

			local npcs = stage.CharacterManager:GetAllNpcs()
			for i = 0, npcs.Count - 1 do
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(npcs[i], get_character('train')) then
					npcs[i].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				end
			end
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
			local black = get_character('black')
			black.Position = vector(-47.5, 0, -27.5)
			black.Direction = character_util.get_direction('left')
			black:SetAnimation('eat', true)

			local wife = get_character('wife')
			wife.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

			local kid = get_character('kid')
			kid.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

			for i = 1, 3 do
				local officer = get_character('officer_' .. i)
				officer.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.current_illusion_progress == self.illusion_progress.did_drug and self:is_illusion_fo(e.FieldObject) then
		local count = random_util.get_random_int(3, 9)
		local start_pos = e.FieldObject.Position

		-- 브레이커블이라면 돈이 나오게 함.
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e.FieldObject.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour) then
			local amount = 10000 * random_util.get_random_int(1, 9)
			for _ = 1, count do
				local drop_pos = vector_util.get_random_point_in_circle(start_pos)
				local gold = CS.Oak.DropGold.Create(start_pos, drop_pos, amount, false, 0.25)
				gold.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
				table.insert(self.drop_items, gold)
			end
		-- 이외의 경우(몬스터 일것)에는 아이템이 나오도록 함.
		else
			local item_name = self.illusion_items[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.illusion_items)]
			local item_id = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName(item_name).Id
			local drop_pos = vector_util.get_random_point_in_circle(start_pos)
			local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = item_id, pos = start_pos, target = drop_pos, sprscale = 0.75 })
			item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
			table.insert(self.drop_items, item)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.illusion_sfx = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil
	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_field_bgm_clip, self))
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:change_field_bgm_clip()
	if (self.quest_progress == nil or not self.quest_progress.IsComplete) and stage.Name == self.unlock_stage_name then
		music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({state = 'field', name = 'bgm_steampunk_basement'})
	end
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:drop_drug(from, to, show_on_character, scale)
	local drug_item_id = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName('drug_crystal').Id
	local drug = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = from, target = to, itemid = drug_item_id, amount = 1,
											  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = scale, showoncharacter = show_on_character })
	local sprite = drug.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	if sprite ~= nil then
		sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 1 })
		sprite:Rebuild()
	end

	return drug
end

function local_class:create_mini_drug(pos)
	local drug = self:drop_drug(pos, nil, true, 0.5)
	drug.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	return drug
end

function local_class:start_illusion()
	self.current_illusion_progress = self.illusion_progress.did_drug
	self.drop_items = {}

	for _, monster in ipairs(self.illusion_monsters) do
		if monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.sender = monster
			heal_info.target = monster
			heal_info.heal = monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

			monster.Position = monster.FieldObjectController.BasePosition
			monster.Direction = monster.FieldObjectController.BaseDirection
		end
	end

	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.illusion_tint_process ,self))
end

function local_class:end_illusion()
	local fade_color = self.fade_color

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ state = 'combat', name = 'bgm_battle_normal' })
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ state = 'field', name = 'bgm_steampunk_basement' })

	self:throw_rock(user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 3, user_party.Leader)

	user_party.Leader.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('confused', true)
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
	self.illusion_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, fade_color, 'linear')

	self.current_illusion_progress = self.illusion_progress.none

	party_util.position_party(vector(-49.5, 0, -14), 'down', 'arc')
	party_util.set_direction('right')

	for _, item in ipairs(self.drop_items) do
		-- 아직 리더한테 먹히지 않은 아이템들은 강제로 해제 시켜줌
		if item.ConsumeTarget ~= nil then
			lua_helper.call_interface(item, 'System.IDisposable', 'Dispose')
		end
	end

	CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.ReturnAll()

	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.75, fade_color, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01' })
	user_party.Leader:RemoveEmotion()
	user_party.Leader:RemoveAnimation()
	character_util.normal_jump_async(user_party.Leader)

	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
	user_party.Leader.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	user_party.Leader.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
end

function local_class:throw_rock(start_pos, target)
	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = 20019, notforinven = true, pos = start_pos,
			  target = target.Position, lootstate = "dontfindlooter", sprscale = 0.3, showoncharacter = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_hit_npc_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	rock:ConsumeComplete()
end

function local_class:illusion_tint_process()
	local tint_name = 'illusion'
	local transition_time = 2
	local colors = {
		unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 1 }),
		unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 1 }),
		unity_color({ 0, 0, 1, 1 }),
	}

	local rotate_angle = 5
	local rotate_speed = 0.1

	local current_color_idx = 1
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_color = unity_class.color.white
	local end_color = colors[current_color_idx]
	while self.current_illusion_progress == self.illusion_progress.did_drug do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local sin_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(2 * unity_class.mathf.PI * unity_class.time.time * rotate_speed)
		stage_camera.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rotate_angle * sin_val, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / transition_time)
		local current_color = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_color, end_color, progress)
		if time_passed >= transition_time then
			time_passed = 0
			start_color = end_color
			current_color_idx = current_color_idx == #colors and 1 or current_color_idx + 1
			end_color = colors[current_color_idx]
		else
			field:Tint(tint_name, current_color, 0, 0.75)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	stage_camera.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
	field:RemoveTint(tint_name)
end

function local_class:is_illusion_fo(fo)
	if fo == nil then return false end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local grid_name = 'illusion_' .. i
		if field:IsInCameraGrid(fo.Position, grid_name) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:scale(transform, start, target, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	while (time_passed < duration) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start, target, progress)
		transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * target
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:setting_section()

	if stage.Name == "easy_forest_1_3" then
		if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.Grade ~= 0 then
			yield_return(self.scene, self.scene_pre_name)

			if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then
				yield_return(self.scene, self.section3_add_name)
			end
		end
	elseif stage.Name == "substage_1_7" then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
			if self.quest_progress.Grade == 0 then
				yield_return(self.scene, self.scene_grade_s_name)
			elseif self.quest_progress.Grade == 2 then
				yield_return(self.scene, self.scene_grade_b_name)
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
				yield_return(self.scene, self.section1_name)
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
				yield_return(self.scene, self.section2_name)
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then
				yield_return(self.scene, self.section3_name)
			end
		end
	end
end

		character.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
	character = nil
end

function local_class:check_civilian_talk(e, character_list, positive)
	if stage.Name ~= "substage_1_7" then
		return
	end

	local cnt = 0

	for key,value in pairs(character_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, value) then
			self:talk_with_civilian(value, cnt, positive)
		end
		cnt = cnt + 1
	end
end

function local_class:talk_with_civilian(character, num, positive)
	local talk_additive
	if positive then
		talk_additive = "0_"
	else
		talk_additive = "1_"
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(character, string.format(
			"%s%s%d", self.talk_name1, talk_additive, num))
end

function local_class:player_move_to_poacher(poacher)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "walk"})

	local entrance_pos = vector(2, 0, 12.5)
	local target_pos = poacher.Position + unity_class.vector3.back

	yield_return_func(move_util.move_to_routine, user_party_leader,
			vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, 0, entrance_pos.z),	{ speed = 3, auto_dir = true})
	yield_return_func(move_util.move_to_routine, user_party_leader,
			vector(target_pos.x, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z),	{ speed = 3, auto_dir = true})
	yield_return_func(move_util.move_to_routine, user_party_leader, target_pos,	{ speed = 3, auto_dir = true})

	user_party_leader:RemoveAnimation()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end


	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:dad_run()
	local check_reset = false

	character_util.set_anim(self.dad, {name = "run"})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.dad, {name = "tired"})

	local poses = {
		vector(95, 0, -74),
		vector(95, 0, -73),
		vector(89, 0, -73),
		vector(88, 0, -73),
		vector(102, 0, -73),
		vector(98, 0, -73),
		vector(98, 0, -74),
	}

	while true do
		if self.dad_index == 4 and check_reset then
			if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party_leader.Position, self.dad.Position) then
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect):Instantiate(poses[4])

		if ip > 5 then
			self:deactivate_characters()
			if ip > 7 then
				self:set_quest_marker_out_of_section(stage.Name)
			end
		end
	elseif stage.Name == 'easy_forest_1_2' then
		if ip > 7 then

			self:set_quest_marker_out_of_section(stage.Name)
		end

		if ip > 8 then
			for i = 1, 7 do
				stage_util.set_fo_active_state(string.format('s9_breakable_%d', i), 'disabled')
			end
			self:deactivate_characters()
			self:set_quest_marker_out_of_section(stage.Name)
		end
	elseif stage.Name == 'easy_forest_1_4' then
		if ip > 9 then
			local fo = get_field_object('trio_trap')

			self:deactivate_characters()
			self:set_quest_marker_out_of_section(stage.Name)
		end
	elseif stage.Name == 'easy_forest_2_5' then
		if ip > 10 then
			self:deactivate_characters()

			if user_progress:IsStageCleared('easy_forest_2_5') then
				local princess = get_character('princess')
				local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
				local item_placeholder = create_item_placeholder({
					id = item_data:GetSpec('princess_handkerchief').Id,
					not_for_inventory = true})
				CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(princess.Position, princess.Position - vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
						item_placeholder)
			end

			self:set_quest_marker_out_of_section(stage.Name)
		end
	elseif stage.Name == 'easy_forest_2_8' then
		if ip >= 12 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('boss_mech_door2'))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('boss_mech_door3'))
		elseif qp.IsComplete then
			self:deactivate_characters()
		end
	end

	stage_util.set_character_active_state('trio_man', 'disabled')
	stage_util.set_character_active_state('princess', 'disabled')

function local_class:align()
	camera_util.move(vector(-22, 0, 29.5), 0.5)

	local dest_list = {
		vector(-22.5, 0, 27),
		vector(-21.5, 0, 27),
		vector(-23.5, 0, 27),
		vector(-20.5, 0, 27),
		vector(-22, 0, 27),
		vector(-23, 0, 27),
		vector(-21, 0, 27),
	}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		if user_party_leader.Position.x > -22 then
			if user_party_leader.Position.z > 29.7 then
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(-20, 0, 30))
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(-20, 0, 27))
			elseif user_party_leader.Position.z > 27.3 then
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(-20, 0, 27))
			end
		else
			if user_party_leader.Position.z > 29.7 then
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(-24, 0, 30))
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(-24, 0, 27))
			elseif user_party_leader.Position.z > 27.3 then
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(-24, 0, 27))
			end
		end

		if user_party.Count == 1 then
			waypoint_list:Add(vector(-22, 0, 27))
		elseif user_party.Count == 3 then
			waypoint_list:Add(dest_list[i + 5])
		else
			waypoint_list:Add(dest_list[i + 1])
		end

		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = "walk"})

		character_util.move_waypoint(user_party[i], waypoint_list, 3, false, "stop", "floor",
		CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
	end

	local waited = 0

	while waited ~= user_party.Count do
		waited = 0

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			if user_party[i].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
				character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = "idle"})
				waited = waited + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))
end

	local basket_2 = self.get_stage_item():Instantiate(dad_pack.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, dad_pack.Transform)

	local stage_item_1 = basket_1:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageItem))
	stage_item_1:SetItem('fox_basket')
	stage_item_1.ShadowActive = true

function local_class:setting_section()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_2_name then
		self:stage_setting_2()
	end

	if stage.Name == self.stage_3_name then
		self:stage_setting_3()
	end

	if stage.Name == self.stage_4_name then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 19 then
			local to_past =  get_character('to_past')
			local to_present = get_character('to_present')

			to_past.Position = vector(0, 0, -1)
			to_present.Position = vector(-28, 0, -74)

			local to_past_wall = get_field_object('to_past_wall')
			local to_present_wall = get_field_object('to_present_wall')

			to_past_wall.Position = vector(0, 0, -1)
			to_present_wall.Position = vector(-28, 0, -74)

			local nari = get_character('nari')
			nari.Position = user_party.Leader.Position - vector(3.5,0,0)
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(nari, user_party, true)

			self:change_water_color(CS.UnityEngine.Color(0, 0.1863025, 0.3113208))
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 14 then
			self:change_water_color(CS.UnityEngine.Color(0, 0.1863025, 0.3113208))
		end
		for wave_count = 1, 3 do
			local i = 1
			while true do
				local bully = get_character('wave_' .. wave_count .. '_' .. i)

				if bully == nil then
					break
				end

				character_util.set_active_state(bully, "disabled")
				i = i + 1
			end
		end

		for i = 1, 6 do
			local worm_game_gate = get_field_object('wormgame_gate_' .. i)
			if worm_game_gate == nil then
				break
			end
			worm_game_gate.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_3_name then
		self:portal_setting(e)

		local nari =  get_character('nari')
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, nari) and self.time_travel_nari then
			if not self.is_tiger then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.change_tiger, self)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nari, { 'change_tiger' }))
			else
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.change_origin_leader, self)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nari, { 'change_origin_leader' }))
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_2_name then
		self:portal_setting_2(e)
		return false
	end

	if stage.Name == self.stage_4_name then

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_3_name then

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(get_character('nari_statue_in'), self.cs_controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(get_character('nari_statue_out'), self.cs_controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(get_character('nari'), self.cs_controller)

	if self.effect_list ~= nil then
		for i, effect in ipairs(self.effect_list) do
			effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.effect_list = nil
	end


	if stage.Name == self.stage_2_name then
		for i = 1, 5 do
			get_field_object('rat_hole_out_' .. i).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end
	end

	self.step_on_callbacks = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

--item_object 는 아이템, aplitude 는 진폭(0 ~ 0.02 사이로 넣는 것이 좋아 보입니다.), duration은 지속 시간
--한 번에 많은 아이템에 쉐이크 넣는 것은 자제해야합니다.
function local_class:item_shake(item_object, amplitude, duration)
	local pos_1 = item_object.SpriteTransform.localPosition
	local pos_2 = item_object.ShadowTransform.localPosition
	local time = 0
	while time < duration do
		local rand_1 = unity_class.random.Range(-amplitude, amplitude)
		local rand_2 = unity_class.random.Range(-amplitude, amplitude)

        item_object.SpriteTransform.localPosition = pos_1 + vector(rand_1, 0, rand_2)
		item_object.ShadowTransform.localPosition = pos_2 + vector(rand_1, 0, rand_2)

		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:load_world_map(section)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black ,'linear')

	-- 파티원 잠시 비활성화
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_state(user_party[i], "disabled")
	end

	local resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local path = "ondemand/fox/theatres"
	local name = "fox_worldmap"
	local map_view_pos = vector(0,0,0)

	local garam_map = get_character('garam_map')
	local kid = get_character('garam_kid_map')
	local garam_pos = {
		vector (-0.7,0.3,-0.5),
		vector (-1,0,-1.2),
		vector (0,0,-1.8),
		vector (0.9,0,-1.45)
	}
	local kid_pos = {
		garam_pos[1]+vector(-0.2,0,0.3),
		garam_pos[2]+vector(-0.2,0,0.3),
		garam_pos[3]+vector(-0.2,0,0.1),
		garam_pos[4]+vector(-0.2,0,-0.1)
	}
	local map_move_speed = 0.3

	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(garam_map.transform, 'Theatres')
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(kid.transform, 'Theatres')

	garam_map:SetGiantFactor('transform', 0.3)
	kid:SetGiantFactor('transform', 0.3)

	local map
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,	resholder, path, name, function(prefab)
		map = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)

		local map_camera = map.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
		local script = map_camera:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
		script.Block = true
		map_camera.transform.localPosition = map_view_pos
		map.transform.localPosition = map_view_pos
		map.transform.localScale = vector(1,1,1)

	end)

	for i=1,6 do
		local stg = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(map.transform, 'stage_'..i)
		stg.name = 'tt' .. i
		local coffee = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(stg.transform, 'cost_info')
		local star = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(stg.transform, 'stars')
		local animator = stg:Find('stage'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		if i == 6 then
			animator:Play('hidden')
		elseif i == 1 then
			animator:Play('stand_up')
			stg:Find('statue_nari'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('stand_up')
		else
			animator:Play('to_after')
		end
		coffee.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		star.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_anim(garam_map,{ name = 'idle', loop = false })
	if section <= 2 then
		character_util.set_position(garam_map, garam_pos[section])
		character_util.set_position(kid, kid_pos[section])
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black ,'linear') -- 페이드 인 하는 시점 : 이동만
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_unlock_03'})
		wait_for_sec(.5)
		if section == 1 then
		character_util.move_to(
				kid, kid_pos[section+1],
				nil,map_move_speed,
				true,true,false
		)
		character_util.move_to_async(
				garam_map, garam_pos[section+1],
				nil, map_move_speed,
				true, true, false
		)
		elseif section == 2 then
			character_util.set_anim(garam_map, {name = 'walk'})
			character_util.move_waypoint(
					garam_map,
					{ garam_pos[section+1], garam_pos[section+2] },
					0.5, false, nil, nil, 'right')
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(
					kid,
					{ kid_pos[section+1], kid_pos[section+2] },
					0.5, false, nil, nil, 'right')
			character_util.remove_anim(garam_map)
			wait_for_sec(0.7)
		end


		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black ,'linear')
	end
	character_util.set_position(garam_map, vector(999,0,999))
	character_util.set_position(kid, vector(999,0,999))

	map:SetActive(false)
	resholder:Dispose()
	-- 파티원 복구
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_state(user_party[i], "enabled")
	end

	--screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black ,'linear')
end

	character_util.add_listener(get_character('nari_statue_out'), self.cs_controller)

	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 8 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 13 then

			local marker =  field:GetMarker('tiger_baby_pos_' .. i).position

			tiger_baby.Position = marker
			tiger_baby.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		for i = 1, 8 do
			local marker = field:GetMarker('tiger_barricade_pos').position

			if i % 2 == 1 then

			else

			for i = 1, 2 do
				local guard = get_character('guard_' .. zone .. '_' .. i)

				else

				character_util.set_position(guard3, daegam_pos + vector(-2, 0, -5.5))
				character_util.set_position(guard5, daegam_pos + vector(-1, 0, -5.5))
				character_util.set_position(guard4, daegam_pos + vector(0, 0, -5.5))
			else

				character_util.set_direction(guard4, 'left')
				character_util.set_direction(guard5, 'left')
				character_util.set_position(guard3, daegam_pos + vector(-5.5, 0, -3.5))
				character_util.set_position(guard4, daegam_pos + vector(-4.5, 0, -3.5))

			end

			-- 호랑이 잡고있는 주민 세팅
			local battle_citizen_pos_2 = {
				vector(2.5, 0, 2),
				vector(2.5, 0, -1),
				vector(5.5, 0, 2),
				vector(5.5, 0, -1)
			}

function local_class:citizen_hit_tiger(i, interval)
	local left = get_character('tiger_battle_2_' .. (i + 8))
	local right = get_character('tiger_battle_2_' .. (i + 10))
	local tiger = get_character('captured_tiger_' .. i)
	local current_pos = left.Position
	character_util.set_direction(left, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(right, 'left')
	-- 이동이 발생하면 호랑이 포효를 들은 것으로 판단
	while current_pos == left.Position do
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(left, {name = 'attack'}, {name = 'attack'})
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		if current_pos ~= left.Position then
			break
		end
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = tiger })
		character_util.remove_anim(left)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(tiger)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(tiger, 1.15, 0.85, 1, 0.2)
		wait_for_sec(interval)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if current_pos ~= left.Position then
			break
		end

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(right, {name = 'attack'}, {name = 'attack'})
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		if current_pos ~= left.Position then
			break
		end
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = tiger })
		character_util.remove_anim(right)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(tiger)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(tiger, 1.15, 0.85, 1, 0.2)
		wait_for_sec(interval)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if current_pos ~= left.Position then
			break
		end
	end
end

--- 포탈에서 나오는 연출. 이 루틴 시작 전에 검은색 Circular FadeOut이 적용되어 있어야 함
--- @param center_pos any Vector3 리더의 최종 위치. y가 0인 것을 권장함
--- @param is_nari_left boolean 최종적으로 나리를 파티 기준으로 왼쪽에 둘 것인지
--- @param align_type string 최종적으로 파티를 Align하는 방식 ('linear' / 'arc')
--- @param callback_after_fade function Black Circular FadeIn 직후에 실행할 함수(혹은 코루틴)
function local_class:exit_portal(center_pos, is_nari_left, align_type, callback_after_fade)
	local portal_pos = center_pos + vector(0, 3.5, 0)
	local factor = is_nari_left and 1 or -1
	local forward = is_nari_left and 'left' or 'right'
	local reverse = is_nari_left and 'right' or 'left'
	local nari = self.get_nari()
	local is_nari_party = user_party:Contains(nari)

	if is_nari_party then
		character_util.convert_to_npc(nari)
	end

	-- 임시 포지션 설정
	nari.Position = portal_pos + vector(-0.2 * factor, 0, 0)
	nari.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 2)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i].Position = portal_pos + vector( -0.05 * factor * i, 0, 0)
		if (i % 2 == 1) == is_nari_left then
			character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], reverse)
		else
			character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], forward)
		end
		user_party[i]:HideWeapon(true)
		user_party[i].SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 2)
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(nari, {name = 'smile'})
	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'surprise'})

	party_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(nari, 0, 0)

	-- 나리가 파티원을 밟을 위치
	local nari_second_pos = center_pos
	-- 나리가 파티원을 밟을 때 실행시킬 파티원에 Squish와 PulseColor를 주는 함수
	local callback = self.step_on_callbacks[user_party.Count]
	if callback == nil then	-- 혹시 모를 오동작 방지
		callback = function() end
	end

	-- 파티 인원 수에 따라 파티원의 Squish와 PulseColor 수준을 각각 다르게 줌
	if user_party.Count == 1 then
		nari_second_pos = center_pos + vector(-0.3 * factor, 0.45, 0)

	elseif user_party.Count == 2 then
		nari_second_pos = center_pos + vector(0, 0.45, 0)

	elseif user_party.Count == 3 then
		nari_second_pos = center_pos + vector(-0.3 * factor, 0.9, 0)

	elseif user_party.Count == 4 then
		nari_second_pos =  center_pos + vector(0, 0.9, 0)
	end

	local party_second_pos = {
		center_pos + vector(-0.3 * factor, 0, 0),
		center_pos + vector( 0.4 * factor, 0.2, 0),
		center_pos + vector(-0.2 * factor, 0.5, 0),
		center_pos + vector(0.3 * factor, 0.7, 0)
	}

	local party_second_rot = {
		-360 * factor,
		(360 - 20) * factor,
		(-360 - 20) * factor,
		360 * factor
	}

	local nari_fall_dur = 0.2
	local fall_dur = {
		0.25, 0.225, 0.2, 0.2
	}

	local nari_final_pos = center_pos + vector(-1.5 * factor, 0, 0)
	local party_final_pos = align_type == 'linear' and {
		center_pos,
		center_pos + vector(0.7 * factor, 0, 0),
		center_pos + vector(1.4 * factor, 0, 0),
		center_pos + vector(2.1 * factor, 0, 0),
	} or {
		center_pos,
		center_pos + vector(0.7 * factor, 0, 0.7),
		center_pos + vector(0.7 * factor, 0, -0.7),
		center_pos + vector(1.4 * factor, 0, 0),
	}

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'ondemand/fox/audio:bgm_fox_sad'})

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	if callback_after_fade ~= nil then
		callback_after_fade()
	end

	local base_offset = unity_class.vector3.back * 10
	local base_target_size = 2.8
	local scale_ratio = stage_camera.Size / base_target_size

	local pooled = self.get_fx_time_travel():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	pooled.transform.parent = stage_camera.Transform.parent
	pooled.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
	pooled.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale_ratio
	pooled.transform.localPosition = base_offset * scale_ratio

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_time_effect_01')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	-- 좌우 대칭이라 factor 사용 없이 위치를 오른쪽 기준으로 잡음
	local portal_effect = self.get_fx_portal():Instantiate(portal_pos + vector(0, 3.5, 0))
	portal_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, -90, 0)
	portal_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	local open_dur = 1

	field:Tint('exit_portal', unity_color({0.6588, 0.251, 1, 1}), open_dur)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, open_dur)

	--music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_portal_01')
	local portal_open_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '01_portal_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2})
	self:portal_appear(portal_effect.transform, open_dur, vector(1.3, 4.5, 1), -2)
	self.get_fx_portal_wind_land():Instantiate(portal_pos)

	camera_util.shake(0.04, 999)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count do
		local member = user_party[i - 1]
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
			character_util.set_anim(member, {name = 'embarrassed'})
			character_util.spine_rotate(member, party_second_rot[i], fall_dur[i])
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(member, 1, 0.2)
			character_util.move_to_async(member, party_second_pos[i], fall_dur[i],
					nil, false, false, false)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_mech_stomp_01')
			character_util.set_anim(member, {name = 'prostrate'})
			character_util.set_emotion(member, {name = 'damaged'})
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(member, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.3)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(member, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
		end))

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		character_util.set_anim(nari, {name = 'dualgun_damaged'})
		character_util.set_direction(nari, forward)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(nari, 1, 0.2)
		character_util.move_to_async(nari, nari_second_pos, nari_fall_dur,
				nil, false, false, false)

		callback()

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(nari)
		character_util.jump(nari, 1, 0.5)

		character_util.move_to_async(nari, nari_final_pos, 0.5,
				nil, false, false, false)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_land_01')
		self.get_fx_jump_smoke():Instantiate(nari_final_pos).transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.set_direction(nari, reverse)
	end))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local close_dur = 1

	field:RemoveTint('exit_portal', close_dur)
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.1, close_dur)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_portal_02')
	portal_open_sfx:FadeOut(1.5)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2})

	self:portal_disappear(portal_effect.transform, close_dur, 2)
	portal_effect:Dispose()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	nari.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)

	for i = user_party.Count, 1, -1 do
		local member = user_party[i - 1]
		member.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.shake(member, 0.04, 0.5)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			character_util.stop_shake(member)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
			character_util.spine_rotate(member, 0, 0)
			if i ~= 1 then
				character_util.move_to(member, party_final_pos[i], 0.3,
						nil, false, false, false)
			end

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
			if i == 1 then
				character_util.mario_jump_async(member, forward, 0.3, 0.5)
			else
				character_util.mario_jump_async(member, reverse, 0.3, 0.5)
			end

			member:HideWeapon(false)
			character_util.set_direction(member, forward)
		end))

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(nari)

	if is_nari_party then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(nari, user_party, true)
	end
end

--- 포탈 커지는 연출
--- @param transform any 포탈 이펙트 오브젝트의 Transform
--- @param duration number 커지는 시간
--- @param target any 마지막에 세팅될 포탈 사이즈
--- @param y_dif number 커지면서 변할 y 좌표
function local_class:portal_appear(transform, duration, target, y_dif)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local origin_pos = transform.localPosition

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - start_time) / duration
		transform.localScale = target * normalized
		transform.localPosition = target.y * 1.5 * normalized * vector(1, 0, 0)
				+ origin_pos + vector(0, normalized * y_dif, 0)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	transform.localScale = target
	transform.localPosition = target.y * 1.5 * vector(1, 0, 0)
			+ origin_pos + vector(0, y_dif, 0)
end

--- 포탈 작아지면서 사라지는 연출. 끝나고 Dispose 잊지 말기
--- @param transform any 포탈 이펙트 오브젝트의 Transform
--- @param duration number 사라질 시간
function local_class:portal_disappear(transform, duration, y_dif)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local origin_scale = transform.localScale
	local origin_pos = transform.localPosition

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - start_time) / duration
		transform.localScale = origin_scale * (1 - normalized)
		transform.localPosition = origin_scale.y * 1.5 * normalized * vector(-1, 0, 0)
				+ origin_pos + vector(0, normalized * y_dif, 0)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	transform.localPosition = origin_scale.y * 1.5 * vector(-1, 0, 0)
			+ origin_pos + vector(0, y_dif, 0)
end

--- 포탈로 빨려 들어가는 연출
--- @param target any 포탈로 빨려 들어갈 캐릭터
--- @param nari_pos number 나리의 포지션
--- @param is_nari boolean 해당 연출을 나리가 사용할 것인지
function local_class:enter_portal(target, nari_pos, is_nari)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(target, false)

	target.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 2)

	local end_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(nari_pos, 4.3)
	local duration = 0.8
	local alpha_dur = 0.1

	if is_nari then
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'get' })
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'cliff' })
		target:HideWeapon(true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local move_end = false

	if is_nari then
		-- 나리가 빙글빙글 돌음
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			local dir = { 'right', 'up', 'left', 'down' }
			local index = 1

			while not move_end do
				character_util.set_direction(target, dir[index])

				index = index + 1 > 4 and 1 or index + 1

				wait_for_sec(0.05)
			end
		end))
	else
		character_util.spine_rotate(target, 360 * 2, duration)
	end

	-- 빨려 들어가는 연출
	character_util.move_to(target, end_pos, duration - alpha_dur, nil)
	wait_for_sec(duration - alpha_dur)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target, 0, alpha_dur)
	wait_for_sec(alpha_dur)

	character_util.set_active_shadow(target, true)
	move_end = true

	target.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
end

--- 나리가 도술 부리는 연출
--- @param camera_move_duration number 나리 중심으로 카메라 이동하는데 걸리는 시간
--- @param dispose_duration number 마지막 이펙트 발생 후 사라지기까지 걸리는 시간
--- @param camera_return_player boolean 나리 중심의 카메라를 리더 중심의 카메라로 변경할 것인지
--- @param camera_resize_duration number 카메라 크기를 default 되는데 걸리는 시간
--- @param remove_duration number 연출이 끝난 후 나리의 애니메이션을 끝내기까지 걸리는 시간
function local_class:nari_magic(camera_move_duration, dispose_duration, camera_return_player,
								camera_resize_duration, remove_duration)

	local camera_move_dur = lua_helper.get_or_default(camera_move_duration, 0.2)
	local dispose_dur = lua_helper.get_or_default(dispose_duration, 5)
	local camera_return = lua_helper.get_or_default(camera_return_player, true)
	local camera_resize_dur = lua_helper.get_or_default(camera_resize_duration, 0.5)
	local remove_dur = lua_helper.get_or_default(remove_duration, 1)

	local nari = get_character('nari')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(nari)
	character_util.set_direction(nari, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(nari.Position, camera_move_dur)

	character_util.set_emotion(nari, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'cast2' })

	-- 나리 무기 생성
	local drop_pos = nari.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0.5)
	local nari_weapon = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = drop_pos, itemid = self.nari_weapon_id,
													 notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
													 showoncharacter = true })

	nari_weapon.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_ficklelady_stomp_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hold_up_effect_name):Instantiate(nari_weapon.Position)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 나리 무기 빙글빙글 도는 연출
	local duration = 2
	local time_passed = 0
	local cur_z = 0

	local light_ready = false
	local light_ready_effect

	camera_util.resize_to(3, duration)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, duration)

	local air_spin_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_air_spin_01', loop = true })

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(time_passed, 0, 360 * 30, duration)
		nari_weapon.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_z)

		-- 일정 시간 회전 후 회전 이펙트 생성
		if time_passed > duration / 4 and not light_ready then
			light_ready = true

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_summon_effect_01')
			light_ready_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(
				self.light_ready_effect_name):Instantiate(nari_weapon.Position + 0.2 * unity_class.vector3.back)

			light_ready_effect.transform.localScale = 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.one
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	air_spin_sfx:Stop()

	light_ready_effect:Dispose()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.spark_effect_name):Instantiate(nari_weapon.Position)

	-- 마지막 이펙트
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_instant_heal_stomp_01')
	local light_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.light_explosion_effect_name):Instantiate(nari_weapon.Position)
	light_effect.transform.localScale = 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.one

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(remove_dur)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(nari)
		nari_weapon:ConsumeComplete()
	end))

	-- fade in을 사용하여 변신할 때 해당 이펙트가 남아있어서 바로 지워주는 용도
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(dispose_dur)

		light_effect:Dispose()
	end))

	-- 카메라를 리더 중심으로 변경
	if camera_return then
		camera_util.resize_to_default(camera_resize_dur)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(camera_resize_dur)
	end
end

function local_class:start_training()
	local trainer = get_character('trainer')
	local trainee = get_character('trainee_5')

	character_util.shake(tiger, 0.035, 9999)

	-- 호랑이한테 겁먹지 마라!

	character_util.remove_anim(trainer)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(trainer, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(trainer, vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_name):Instantiate(tiger.Position)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(trainee, trainee.Position + 2 * unity_class.vector3.left, 4)

	while self.play_training do
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(trainee, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(trainee, vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.5)

		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(tiger)

function local_class:portal_setting_2(e)
	local time_travel = function(start_pos, end_pos)
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			local nari = get_character('nari')
			character_util.convert_to_npc(nari)

			camera_util.move(start_pos, 0.5)

			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(party_util.align_to_target, start_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'arc'),
				util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, nari, start_pos, 1, nil, true, true)
			})

			self:nari_portal()

			camera_util.move(end_pos, 0)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			self:exit_portal(end_pos, true, 'arc')

			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(nari, user_party, true)
		end)
	end

	local to_past = get_field_object('to_past_object')
	local to_present = get_field_object('to_present_object')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, to_past) then
		time_travel(to_past.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
				to_present.Position + vector(4,0, 0))
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, to_present) then
		time_travel(to_present.Position + vector(2,0, 0),
				to_past.Position + vector(4, 0, 0))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 과거 현재 연결하는 포탈 세팅
function local_class:portal_setting(e)
	local in_portal = get_character('nari_statue_in')
	local out_portal = get_character('nari_statue_out')
	local nari = get_character('nari')

	local time_travel = function(end_pos, is_nari_left, add_nari)
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			character_util.convert_to_npc(nari)

			local move_pos = e.Target.Position + 1.5 * unity_class.vector3.right
			character_util.move_to(nari, move_pos, 1, nil, true, true)
			party_util.align_party(move_pos, 'right', 1, 'arc')

			self:nari_portal()

			camera_util.move(end_pos, 0)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			self:exit_portal(end_pos, is_nari_left, 'arc')

			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

			if add_nari then
				character_util.convert_to_party_member(nari, user_party, true)
			end
		end)
	end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, in_portal) then
		local marker = field:GetMarker('past_start_pos').position
		time_travel(marker, true, false)
		out_portal.Position = marker + vector(-1, 0, -1)
		character_util.add_listener(nari, self.cs_controller)
		self.time_travel_nari = true
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, out_portal) then
		time_travel(in_portal.Position + vector(1, 0, 1), false, true)
		return true
	end
end

-- 과거 현재 연결하는 포탈 세팅
function local_class:portal_setting_4(e)
	local time_travel = function(start_pos, end_pos)
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			local nari = get_character('nari')
			party_util.align_party(start_pos, 'up', 1, 'arc')
			character_util.move_to_async(nari, start_pos, 0.5, nil, true, true)
			self:nari_portal()

			camera_util.move(end_pos, 0)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			self:exit_portal(end_pos, false, 'arc')

			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
		end)
	end

	local end_portal = get_field_object('to_past_wall')
	local to_present = get_field_object('to_present_wall')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, end_portal) then
		time_travel(end_portal.Position + vector(-2,0,-1), to_present.Position + vector(-2,0,-1))
		to_present.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, to_present) then
		time_travel(to_present.Position + vector(-2,0,-1), end_portal.Position + vector(-2, 0, -1))
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:change_water_color(color)
	local layer = stage.StageGameObject.transform:Find(stage.Name .. '/obj_water/')
	local child_count = layer.childCount
	for i = 0, child_count - 1 do
	   local tile = layer:GetChild(i)
	   local renderer = tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
	   renderer.sharedMaterial = CS.UnityEngine.Material(renderer.sharedMaterial)
	   renderer.sharedMaterial:SetColor("_TintColor", color)
	end
 end

		get_character('red_crew_3'),
		get_character('red_crew_4'),
		get_character('red_crew_5'),

		get_character('red_crew_8'),
		get_character('red_crew_9'),
		get_character('red_crew_10'),
		get_character('yellow_crew_1'),
		get_character('yellow_crew_2'),
		get_character('yellow_crew_3'),
	}

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'change_tiger' then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			for _, c in ipairs(event_characters) do
				c.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		end

		self:event_gimmicks_set_active(false)
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'change_origin_leader' then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			for _, c in ipairs(event_characters) do
				c.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			end
		end

		self:event_gimmicks_set_active(true)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:event_gimmicks_set_active(active)
	local starpiece_items = {
		get_field_object('startrek_star_piece'),
		get_field_object('startrek_blocker'),
	}
	if active then
		for _, fo in ipairs(self.disabled_gimmicks) do
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		end
		self.disabled_gimmicks = {}

		if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece('startrek_star_piece') then
			for _, item in ipairs(starpiece_items) do
				item.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			end
		end
	else
		local zone = field:GetZone('startrek_zone')
		local names = {
			'[breakable]leaf1',
			'[GIMMICK]bomb_grass1',
			'startrek_bomb',
			'[GIMMICK]bomb1',
			'startrek_reset'
		}

		local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, zone.Bounds)

		for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
			local fo = fo_list[i]
			if table_util.contain_value(names, fo.Name) then
				fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				table.insert(self.disabled_gimmicks, fo)
			end
		end

		fo_list:Dispose()

		if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece('startrek_star_piece') then
			for _, item in ipairs(starpiece_items) do
				item.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

		get_character('tazza_audience_6'),
		get_character('tazza_audience_7'),
		get_character('tazza_audience_8')
	}

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'change_tiger' then
		for _, c in ipairs(event_characters) do
			c.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
			self.star_piece_effect.transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end

		if self.quest_progress == nil then
			local hogu = get_character('hogu')
			quest_icon_util.remove(hogu)
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'change_origin_leader' then
		-- 아직 타짜를 이기지않은 상황일때는 모든 캐릭터들의 비활성화를 풀어줌.
		if self.quest_progress == nil or (self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 and not self.sections[1].defeat_tazza and not
				self.quest_progress.IsComplete) then
			for _, c in ipairs(event_characters) do
				c.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			end
		-- 타짜를 이긴 상황에서는 hogu와 관중들만 비활성화를 풀어줌
		else
			for _, c in ipairs(complete_event_characters) do
				c.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			end
		end

		if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
			self.star_piece_effect.transform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end

		-- 호구 퀘스트 아이콘 설정
		local hogu = get_character('hogu')
		if self.quest_progress == nil then
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(hogu)
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			local defeated_tazza = self.sections[1].defeat_tazza
			if not defeated_tazza then

	-- 성당 그리드 안에 들어왔는지?
	self.is_in_church_grid = false

	-- 성당 그리드 이름
	self.grid_church_name = 'church_grid'
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.sections = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		self:on_stage_start_event(e)
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_4 then
		local linda_desk = get_field_object(self.linda_desk_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, linda_desk) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_linda_desk, self, linda_desk)
			return true
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_name_5 then
		local linda_computer = get_field_object(self.linda_computer)
		local church_sign = get_field_object('church_sign')
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, linda_computer) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_linda_computer, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, church_sign) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(church_sign, { key = 'futurecastle_bob_linda_sign_3', bubble_direction = 'rt' })
		end

end

end

end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	-- 5 스테이지 일경우에는 베타 웨폰 루핑 기능 추가
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_5 then
		-- 베타 웨폰 행동 시작
		local custom_state_key = self.quest_progress.IsComplete and 'start_loop_weak' or 'start_loop'
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { custom_state_key }))

		-- 퀘스트를 클리어하지 않았다면 린다 시험관에게 상호작용 가능하도록
		if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			local linda_glass_tube = self.get_linda_glass_tube()
			linda_glass_tube.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		else
			self:set_disable_tint_linda_glass_tube()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name_5 then
		return false
	end

	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return false
	end

	-- 카메라 그리드 안으로 들어왔을 때 린다 둥둥떠있는 연출
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.grid_church_name) then
		self.is_in_church_grid = true
		local linda = self.get_linda()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.float_linda, self, linda))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name_5 then
		return false
	end

	if not self.is_in_church_grid then
		return false
	end

	-- 카메라 그리드 밖으로 나갔을 때 린다 둥둥떠있는 연출 제거
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.grid_church_name) then
		self.is_in_church_grid = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_disable_tint_linda_glass_tube()
	local linda_glass_tube = self.get_linda_glass_tube()
	local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(linda_glass_tube.Transform, 'obj_glasstube')
	local renderer = mesh:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
	renderer.material:SetColor("_TintColor", CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.349, 0.203, 0.4509, 0.30588))

	local bubble_effect = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(linda_glass_tube.transform, 'fx_future_glasstube_bubble_inside')
	bubble_effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

function local_class:set_target_state(target, pos)
	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_position(target, pos)
	character_util.set_active_state(target, 'enabled')
	character_util.add_listener(target, self)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(target, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
end

function local_class:set_linda_state()
	local linda = self.get_linda()
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(linda, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	character_util.set_position(linda, vector(-27.5, 0, 78))
	character_util.set_anim(linda, { name = 'idle', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(linda, { name = 'empty' })
	character_util.set_active_state(linda, 'enabled')

	linda.SpineController:AddColor(linda.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
end

function local_class:float_linda(linda)
	local deg = 0
	local start_y = 0.1
	local move_y = 0.25
	local duration = 3
	local dir = 1

	while self.is_in_church_grid do
		if deg >= 90 then
			dir = -1
		elseif deg < 0 then
			dir = 1
		end

		deg = deg + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 90 / duration * dir
		local cur_y = start_y + move_y * math.sin(deg * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)
		if linda.ActiveState ~= active_state('disabled') then
			linda.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = narration_first_text .. (is_complete and 4 or 2) })

		return false
	end

	if self.in_coco_room == true then
		return false
	end

	self.in_coco_room = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ice_statue_push, self))

	return true

	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.coco_grid_name) == false then
		return
	end

	self.in_coco_room = false

	return true
end

--region ice_statue_push
function local_class:ice_statue_push()
	local ice_statue_character_list = {}
	local ice_statue_list = {}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local ice_statue_character = self.get_ice_statue_character(i)
		local ice_statue = self.get_ice_statue(i)

		character_util.set_active_state(ice_statue_character, 'visible')
		stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(ice_statue_character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

		table.insert(ice_statue_character_list, ice_statue_character)
		table.insert(ice_statue_list, ice_statue)
	end

	while self.in_coco_room do
		for i = 1, #ice_statue_character_list do

	self.stage_name = 'futurecastle_1_2'

	self.get_grave = function(num) return get_field_object('gravestone_' .. num) end

	-- 묘지 zone 이름
	self.cemetry_zone_name = 'cemetery'

	self.pushable_index_list = {
		2, 9, 11
	}

	self.interactable_index_list = {
		1, 3, 10
	}

	-- 특이 케이스들
	self.except_index_list = {
		4, 5, 6, 7, 8
	}

	--
	self.except_grave_key = {
		'grave_stone_eva',
		'grave_stone_marvin',
		{'grave_stone_fei', 'grave_stone_mei'},
		'grave_stone_shapira',
		'grave_stone_knight',
	}

	self.is_move_checking = false

	self.obj_state = {
		none = 0,
		moving = 1,
		done = 2

function local_class:load_resource()

end


function local_class:load_progress()
