end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete and not star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.star_piece_name) then
		star_piece_util.show_hidden_star_piece(self.star_piece_name)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	for _, index in pairs(self.pushable_index_list) do
		local grave = self.get_grave(index)
		local behaviour = grave.FieldObjectBehaviour
		cast(behaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectBehaviour))

		table.insert(self.pushable_grave_infos, {
			grave = grave,
			behaviour = behaviour,
			state = self.obj_state.none,
			origin_pos = grave.Position
		})
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'FutureCastleCemeteryParkSection1')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'FutureCastleCemeteryParkPostSection')
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for _, index in pairs(self.interactable_index_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grave(index)) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(field_ui_util.show_narration_async,
					{ key = 'futurecastle_cemetry_park_' .. index })
			return true
		end
	end

	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(151)
	if main_quest ~= nil and (main_quest.InnerProgress > 6 or main_quest.IsComplete) then
		for k, index in pairs(self.except_index_list) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grave(index)) then
				local nar_key = self.except_grave_key[k]

				if type_util.is_table(nar_key) then
					if user:GetCharacter(CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.ChinaHeroBoy, true) ~= nil then
						nar_key = nar_key[1]
					else
						nar_key = nar_key[2]
					end
				end

				if index == 8 then
					nar_key = game_string:Format(nar_key, user.Name)
				end

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(field_ui_util.show_narration_async, { key = nar_key })

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.cemetry_zone_name) then
		self:start_move_check_routine()
	end

end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.cemetry_zone_name) then
		self:stop_move_check_routine()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_move_check_routine()
	if self.is_move_checking == false then
		self.is_move_checking = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_check_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:stop_move_check_routine()
	self.is_move_checking = false
end

function local_class:move_check_routine()
	while self.is_move_checking do
		for k, infos in pairs(self.pushable_grave_infos) do
			if infos.state == self.obj_state.none
					and infos.behaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Moving then
				self.pushable_grave_infos[k].state = self.obj_state.moving

			elseif infos.state == self.obj_state.moving
					and infos.behaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
				if not (infos.grave.Position - infos.origin_pos):IsAlmostZero() then
					self.pushable_grave_infos[k].grave.Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance
					self.pushable_grave_infos[k].state = self.obj_state.done
				else
					-- 벽에 막혀 움직이지 않았을 때에는 State 초기화
					self.pushable_grave_infos[k].state = self.obj_state.none
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for k, infos in pairs(self.pushable_grave_infos) do
		if infos.state == self.obj_state.moving then
			self.pushable_grave_infos[k].grave.Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance
			self.pushable_grave_infos[k].state = self.obj_state.done
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.pushable_index_list = nil
	self.pushable_grave_infos = nil
	self.interactable_index_list = nil
	self.obj_state = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	--- 눈보라 preset

	--- 눈보라 페이드 preset

	--- fx preload
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_preset)

	-- preset load
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self.preset.blizzard = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(blizzard_preset_name)
		self.preset.blizzard_fade = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fade_preset_name)

		-- particle system 조정에 쓰일 gradient 생성
		-- stage 진행 중 생성할 경우 끊기는 현상이 발생해, 미리 생성
		self.fade.gradient = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(unity_class.color.black)

		local object_pool_extensions = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions

		-- 이펙트 로드 대기
		while not object_pool_extensions.IsLoaded(self.preset.blizzard) or
			not object_pool_extensions.IsLoaded(self.preset.blizzard_fade) do

		end

end

--region blizzard
--- 눈보라 이펙트 셋업
function local_class:blizzard_start(args)
	if self.blizzard == nil or self.fade == nil then return end
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil or self.fade.obj ~= nil then return end

	local with_fade = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'with_fade', true)
	local alpha = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'alpha', -1)
	local custom_alpha = false

	if not float_util.almost_close_to(alpha, -1) then
		custom_alpha = true
	end

	local camera = stage_camera

	self.blizzard.obj = self.preset.blizzard:Instantiate(
		camera.Transform.position + vector(0, 5, 10), unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
	self.blizzard.material = self.blizzard.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
		typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	local target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.blizzard.color.a * 0.2

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
		{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, target_alpha }))

	if with_fade then
		self.fade.obj = self.preset.blizzard_fade:Instantiate(
			camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
		self.fade.main_module = self.fade.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

		target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.fade.color.a * 0.2

		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
			{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, target_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

-- 눈보라 이펙트 알파값 업데이트
function local_class:blizzard_update(alpha, fade_alpha)
	if fade_alpha == nil then
		fade_alpha = alpha
	end

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
		{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, alpha }))

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
			{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, fade_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
	end
end

-- 눈보라 완전히 사라지게 설정
function local_class:blizzard_fade_max()
	if self.fade.obj == nil then return end

	self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color({ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, 1 })

	self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
end

-- 눈보라 Material Color 원래 값으로 복구
function local_class:blizzard_color_refresh()
	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

--- 눈보라 관련 이펙트 dispose
function local_class:blizzard_dispose()
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil then
		self.blizzard.material = nil
		self.blizzard.color = nil
		self.blizzard.obj:Dispose()
		self.blizzard.obj = nil
	end

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.main_module = nil
		self.fade.color = nil
		self.fade.obj:Dispose()
		self.fade.obj = nil
	end
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:generate_roses()
	self.rose_list = {}
	local count = 0
	local karina = self:get_karina()
	while count < 10 do
		local x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1, 1)
		local z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1, 1)

		local throw_pos = vector(karina.Position.x, karina.Position.y, karina.Position.z) + vector(x, 0, z)
		local itemid = 20220

		local trash_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = throw_pos, itemid = itemid, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
				, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

		local rotation = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 360)
		trash_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, rotation, 0)
		trash_item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, rotation, 0)
		table.insert(self.rose_list, trash_item)

		count = count + 1
	end
end

function local_class:setting_pre()
	local thepeople = self:get_people()

	for i, v in ipairs(thepeople) do
		v.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_karina_refugee_pre_'..((i%3)+1)
	end

	local karina_t = self:get_karina()
	karina_t.Position = karina_t.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.back
	character_util.set_direction(karina_t, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(karina_t, {name = 'idle'})
	local karina_m = self:get_mummy_karina()
	karina_m.Position = karina_t.Position + 0.01 * unity_class.vector3.back
	character_util.set_direction(karina_m, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(karina_m, {name = 'idle'})

	self:generate_roses()
	local karina = self:get_alive_karina()
	character_util.set_active_state(karina, 'disabled')
	karina.Position = karina_t.Position
	character_util.set_direction(karina, 'down')

	local oldman = self:get_oldman()
	oldman.Position = oldman.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.forward

	for i, v in ipairs(thepeople) do
		v.Position = v.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.forward
	end

end

function local_class:setting_post()
	local oldman = self:get_oldman()

	oldman.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_karina_old_post'
	character_util.set_direction(oldman, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(oldman, { name = 'smile' })

	local thepeople = self:get_people()
	local karina = self:get_karina()


	for i, v in ipairs(thepeople) do
		if v.Position.x > karina.Position.x then
			character_util.set_direction(v, 'left')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(v, 'right')
		end
		v.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_karina_refugee_post_'..((i%3)+1)
		if i % 3 ~= 1 or i == 1 then
			local tmp = i % 4 + 1
			if tmp > 3 then tmp = 1 end
			character_util.set_anim(v, { name = self.post_anim[tmp] })
		end
		character_util.set_emotion(v, { name = 'smile'})
	end

	local karina = self:get_karina()
	character_util.set_active_state(karina, 'disabled')
	local karina_m = self:get_mummy_karina()
	character_util.set_active_state(karina_m, 'disabled')
	local alivekarina = self:get_alive_karina()
	character_util.set_active_state(alivekarina, 'disabled')
end

		CS.MessyText.PreLoad()
	end

function local_class:setting_section()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if stage.Name == self.stage_1_name then
			self.shoot_helper_dict = create_generic_dictionary(CS.Oak.Character, CS.Oak.ShootHelper)
			self.is_battle_dict = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Object)

			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
				for i = 1, self.stage_1_statue_breakable_num do
					stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.stage_1_statue_breakable_name..i, 'disabled')
				end
			else
				for i = 1, self.stage_1_statue_rock_num do
					stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.stage_1_statue_rock_name..i, 'disabled')
				end
			end

			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 1 then
				-- 불 제거
				for i = 1, self.stage_1_fire_num do
					stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.stage_1_fire_obj_name..i, 'disabled')
				end
			end

			local future_princess = get_character(self.future_princess_name)
			future_princess:HideWeapon(true)

			-- 파티 비활성화
			self:deactivate_party()
		elseif stage.Name == self.stage_2_name then
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 10 then
				for i = 1, self.stage_2_blocked_block_num do
					stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.stage_2_blocked_block_name..i, 'disabled')
				end
			end

			local future_princess = get_character(self.future_princess_name)
			future_princess:HideWeapon(true)

			-- 불 제거
			for i = 1, self.stage_2_fire_num do
				stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.stage_2_fire_obj_name..i, 'disabled')
			end

			-- 배리어 체크용 벽 제거
			for i = 1, self.stage_2_barrier_wall_num do
				stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.stage_2_barrier_wall_name..i, 'disabled')
			end

			-- 파티 비활성화
			self:deactivate_party()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	local target = hit_info.target

	if target ~= nil and not lua_helper.reference_equals(target, user_party_leader) then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset):Instantiate(target.Position)

		-- 타겟이 Character이면 맞는 액션 처리
		if lua_helper.type_compare(target, CS.Oak.Character) then
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(target, hit_info.direction.normalized * 0.3, 0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
		end
	end
end

-- 파티 비활성화
function local_class:deactivate_party()
	self.party_list = {}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local cur_party_member = user_party[i]

		table.insert(self.party_list, cur_party_member)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.party_list do
		if i ~= 1 then
			character_util.convert_to_npc(self.party_list[i])

			self.party_list[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	end
end

function local_class:activate_party()
	for i = 1, #self.party_list do
		if i ~= 1 then
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.party_list[i], user_party, false)

			self.party_list[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end
	end
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (단순하게 합 주고 받음)
function local_class:battle_template_attack_repeat(key, char_1, char_2)
	self:play_battle(key)

	while CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) do
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_normal(key, char_1, char_2))

		coroutine.yield(self:attack_normal(key, char_2, char_1))
	end
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (서로 힘겨루기하며 밀고 당김)
function local_class:battle_template_power_struggle(key, char_1, char_2, dist, duration)
	self:play_battle(key)

	local cur_dist = lua_helper.get_or_default(dist, 0.5)
	local cur_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 2)

	local dir_1 = (char_2.Position - char_1.Position).normalized
	local dir_2 = (char_1.Position - char_2.Position).normalized

	character_util.shake(char_1, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_1, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.shake(char_2, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })

	character_util.move_to_async(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist,
			0.1, nil, false, false)

	while CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) do
		character_util.move_to(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		character_util.move_to(char_2, char_2.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < cur_duration do
			if not CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.move_to(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_2 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		character_util.move_to(char_2, char_2.Position + dir_2 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < cur_duration do
			if not CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (한 쪽은 일반 공격을 하고 다른 쪽이 계속 막고 있음)
function local_class:battle_template_defense(key, char_1, char_2)
	self:play_battle(key)

	while CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) do
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_and_defense(key, char_1, char_2))
	end
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 리스트 처리 (한 쪽은 일반 공격을 하고 다른 쪽이 계속 막고 있음)
function local_class:battle_template_defense_list(key, char_1_list, char_2_list, dir)
	self:play_battle(key)

	while CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) do
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_and_defense_list(key, char_1_list, char_2_list, dir))
	end
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (서로 공격하고 막다가 한 쪽이 강 공격 시전)
function local_class:battle_template_defense_with_counter(key, char_1, char_2, defense_num)
	self:play_battle(key)

	for i = 0, defense_num do
		if not CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
			break
		end

		if i % 2 == 0 then
			coroutine.yield(self:attack_and_defense(key, char_1, char_2))
		else
			coroutine.yield(self:attack_and_defense(key, char_2, char_1))
		end
	end

	if CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_with_knockback(key, char_1, char_2, false))
	end
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (서로 공격하고 막다가 한 쪽이 강 공격 시전 후 돌아와서 무한 반복)
function local_class:battle_template_defense_with_counter_repeat(key, char_1, char_2, defense_num)
	self:play_battle(key)

	while CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) do
		for i = 0, defense_num do
			coroutine.yield(self:attack_and_defense(key, char_1, char_2))
		end

		coroutine.yield(self:attack_with_knockback_and_recover(key, char_1, char_2))
	end
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (한 쪽은 프로젝타일 공격을 하고 다른 쪽이 계속 막고 있음)
function local_class:battle_template_projectile_defense(key, char_1, char_2, shoot_delay)
	self:play_battle(key)

	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'push' })

	while CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) do
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_projectile(key, char_1, char_2, shoot_delay))
	end
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (한 쪽은 프로젝타일 공격을 하고 다른 쪽은 공격을 버티면서 움직여서 반격 시전)
function local_class:battle_template_projectile_defense_counter(key, char_1, char_2, speed, is_air_spin, shoot_delay)
	self:play_battle(key)

	local dir = (char_1.Position - char_2.Position).normalized

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_list:Add(char_1.Position - dir)

	character_util.move_waypoint(char_2, waypoint_list, speed, false, 'stop', 'floor', char_2.Direction)

	while char_2.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped and CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) do
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_projectile(key, char_1, char_2, shoot_delay))
	end

	if CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_with_knockback(key, char_2, char_1, is_air_spin))
	else
		character_util.stop(char_2)
	end
end

-- 다대1 전투 연출 (무차별 공격)
function local_class:battle_template_lynch(key_list, attacker_list, target, delay, is_prostrate)
	for i = 0, key_list.Count - 1 do
		self:play_battle(key_list[i])
	end

	if is_prostrate then
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'prostrate' })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'push' })
	end

	while attacker_list.Count > 0 do
		for i = 0, attacker_list.Count - 1 do
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.attack_normal, self, key_list[i], attacker_list[i], target, is_prostrate))

			local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
			local finished = false

			while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < delay do
				if not CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key_list[i]) then
					finished = true

					break
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if finished then
				attacker_list:RemoveAt(i)
				key_list:RemoveAt(i)

				break
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 해당하는 키의 전투 연출 시작
function local_class:play_battle(key)
	if not self.is_battle_dict:ContainsKey(key) then
		self.is_battle_dict:Add(key, true)
	else
		-- 중복 키 오류 검출
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Battle Dictionary already has same key')
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError(key)
	end
end

-- 해당하는 키의 전투 연출 중단
function local_class:stop_battle(key)
	if self.is_battle_dict:ContainsKey(key) then
		self.is_battle_dict:Remove(key)
		self.is_battle_dict:Add(key, false)
	end
end

-- 공격 연출 (A가 B를 때리고 B는 데미지 입고 원위치로)
function local_class:attack_normal(key, char_1, char_2, no_anim)
	local no_anim_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(no_anim, false)

	local dir = (char_2.Position - char_1.Position).normalized

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(char_1, dir * 0.7, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local duration = 0.3

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if not CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = char_2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.spine_pulse_color(char_2, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(char_2, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(char_2, dir * 0.5, 0.3, 0.2)

	if not no_anim_val then
		character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

function local_class:preload_shooter(char_1, projectile_name, shoot_weapon_id)
	local cur_projectile_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(projectile_name, self.invader_arrow_name)
	local cur_shoot_weapon_id = lua_helper.get_or_default(shoot_weapon_id, self.invader_bow_id)

	local basic_rifle_id = cur_shoot_weapon_id
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local rifle_data = item_data:GetSpec(basic_rifle_id).Data
	local rifle_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(rifle_data, 'ShootOffset', 0.5)

	local projectile_data = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Object)
	projectile_data:Add("Columns", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(1))
	projectile_data:Add("SpreadAngle", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(0))
	projectile_data:Add("Parallel", true)
	projectile_data:Add("Projectile", cur_projectile_name)
	projectile_data:Add("ShootOffset", rifle_offset)

	local pattern_info = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_pattern(projectile_data)
	local spec = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_spec(projectile_data)

	-- 투사체 발사용 ShootHelper가 딕셔너리에 없는 경우 추가함
	if not self.shoot_helper_dict:ContainsKey(char_1) then
		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, char_1)
		local cur_shoot_helper = shoot_helper_util.create_shoot_helper_by_spec(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional
		, ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)
		self.shoot_helper_dict:Add(char_1, cur_shoot_helper)
	end
end

		if self.refuge_alert_holder == nil then

--- @param life_time number 이 UI가 보일 시간. 기본값은 2
function local_class:show_refugee_alert_async(key, y, life_time)
	life_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(life_time, 2)
	y = lua_helper.get_or_default(y, 0)

	local root = self:get_refugee_alert_ui()
	root.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local label = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(root.transform, 'Label'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))
	label.text = game_string:GetString(key)

	local bar = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(root.transform, 'Bar')
	local normal = (y - -1) / (1 - -1)
	local target_y = field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera:ViewportToWorldPoint(unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5 + unity_class.vector3.up * normal).y

	local max_height = field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera:ViewportToWorldPoint(unity_class.vector3.up).y
	local bar_hegiht = bar:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIWidget)).height
	target_y = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(target_y, -max_height + (bar_hegiht / 2), max_height - (bar_hegiht / 2))-- 화면 높이에 알맞게 클램핑
	bar.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.up * target_y

	wait_for_sec(life_time)

	-- 풀로 되돌림
	root.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	table.insert(self.refugee_alert_pool, root)
end

	self.shoot_helper_dict = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil

		self.refuge_alert_holder:Dispose()
		self.refuge_alert_holder = nil
	end

	if self.refugee_alert_pool ~= nil then
		for _, alert_ui in pairs(self.refugee_alert_pool) do
			if not is_unity_null(alert_ui) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(alert_ui.gameObject)
			end
		end

	end

		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)
end

return {

		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @

]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, scene)

	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	-- 시작 나레이션을 봤는지
	self.saw_start = false
	self.saw_mid = false

	-- 정답 경로 : 맨 마지막은 항상 reset
	self.answer_list = { 'down', 'left', 'left', 'up', 'right' }

	-- 미로 한 구역의 길이

	-- 배틀을 진행했는지 체크

	self.battle_2 = false

	-- 전투를 진행하는 몬스터 수

	self.battle_2_count = 2

	-- 배틀게이트 수
	self.battle_gate_num = 8

	-- 배틀게이트 이름
	self.battle_gate_name = 'battle_gate_'

	-- 미로를 통과 했는지
	self.clear_labyrinth = false

	self.sub_stage_name = 'substage_10_3'

	-- 사운드 재생 루프용
	self.sound_1_playing = false
	self.sound_2_playing = false

	-- 사운드 볼륨

	-- 오픈 이전 스테이지
	self.main_stage_name = 'futurecastle_1_4'

	-- 해카테와 대화를 했는지
	self.saw_sniper = false

	-- 스나이퍼 연출용 이펙트
	self.get_fx_targetcircle_loop = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_targetcircle_typeb_loop')
	end

	self.get_fx_targetcircle_end = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_targetcircle_typeb_end')
	end

	-- 저격 존에 들어와 있는지
	self.in_sniper_zone = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	if self.sub_stage_name == stage.Name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	end

	if self.main_stage_name == stage.Name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_main_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_main_zone_leave_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_main_hold_up_event')
	end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	if stage.Name == self.main_stage_name then
		quest_util.load_pool_resource(
				'FX_dead',
				'custom_sprite',
				'Manual_AssaultRifle_Sniper_Bullet_SmokeTrail',
				'fx_targetcircle_typeb_loop',
				'fx_targetcircle_typeb_end'
		)
		self:preload_bullet_async()
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.setting_section, self))
end

function local_class:setting_section()
	if self.sub_stage_name == stage.Name then
		-- 미로 통로 비활성화
		local labyrinth_stair = get_field_object('labyrinth_stair')
		labyrinth_stair.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		self.original_positions = { }
		for i=1, self.battle_1_count do
			local battle_monster = get_character('battle_1_' .. i)
			battle_monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
			self.original_positions[battle_monster] = battle_monster.Position
		end
		for i=1, self.battle_2_count do
			local battle_monster = get_character('battle_2_' .. i)
			battle_monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
			self.original_positions[battle_monster] = battle_monster.Position
		end

		-- 미로 몬스터 비활성화 세팅
		self:active_monster(1, 'disabled')
		self:active_monster(2, 'disabled')

		local fake_exit = get_field_object('fake_exit')
		local tmp = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2,0,4))
		fake_exit.Hitbox = tmp

	end

	if self.main_stage_name == stage.Name then
		local sniper = get_character('sniper')
		sniper.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'nw_2000_sniper_rifle')
		character_util.set_anim(sniper, {name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false, scale = 0})
		if not user_progress:IsStageOpened('substage_10_3') then
			sniper.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
		else
			local tmp = get_field_object('phone_rock')
			tmp.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'FutureCastleMessagePreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'FutureCastleMessageSection1')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'FutureCastleMessagePostSection')
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.main_stage_name == stage.Name and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('sniper')) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_sniper, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('phone')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_phone, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_main_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then
		return false
	end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'sniper_zone' then
		self.in_sniper_zone = true

		local current_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

		if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			local target = current_state.HoldTarget
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.break_holdable, self, target)
		end

		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_main_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then
		return false
	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then
		return false
	end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'sniper_zone' then
		self.in_sniper_zone = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_main_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, user_party.Leader) and self.in_sniper_zone then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.break_holdable, self, e.Target)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 폰을 습득할 경우
function local_class:get_phone()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.set_side_direction(user_party.Leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat', count = 3})
	get_field_object('phone').Position = vector(999,0,999)

	self.phone_item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	-- 정체불명의 시그널이 들려온다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_message_pre_9', mintotalduration = 1 })

	if self.quest_progress == nil then
		self.pre_story_section:on_next_section()
	end
end

-- 물건을 들고 해카테 주변에 있으면
function local_class:break_holdable(object)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local sniper = get_character('sniper')
	character_util.set_direction(sniper, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(sniper)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(sniper, {name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false, scale = 1.5})
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	time_util.mod('attack', 0.3)
	-- 헤카테 씬
	self.wait_sniper = true
	local wait_set = function() self.wait_sniper = false end

	-- 초기 위치
	local temp = object.Position + vector(0,0,0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_targeted_03' })
	local end_scope =self.get_fx_targetcircle_end():Instantiate(temp)
	end_scope.transform.localScale = vector(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.05)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.shoot_to_target, self,
					sniper.Position + vector(0.6,0,0.5), object, wait_set, vector(0,-0.5,-0.3)))

	wait_for_sec(0.05)


	time_util.unmod('attack')


	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent.Create(object, object.Position, object.Hitbox))
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_rock_break_01' })

	-- 부순 오브젝트가 무전기가 들어있는 바위라면
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(object, get_field_object('phone_rock')) then
		self.phone_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = object.Position, target = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-2,0,0),
				  itemid = 20017, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_touch_laser_cannon_01' })

		get_field_object('phone').Position = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-2,0,0)
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(object.Position)
	object.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed'})
	party_util.jump(0.5,0.3)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(sniper, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	camera_util.move_async(sniper.Position, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01' })
	-- 방해되잖아! 내 주변에서 물건 높이 들지마!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, { key = 'futurecastle_message_pre_8', skip = true })
	character_util.set_direction(sniper, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(sniper, {name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false, scale = 0})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gun_ready_01' })
	character_util.remove_emotion(sniper)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
end

-- 헤카테와 대화
function local_class:talk_sniper()
	local sniper = get_character('sniper')
	get_character('sniper').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	self.saw_sniper = true

	party_util.align_to_target(sniper, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	-- 거기, 가지고 온 탄약은 옆에 두고 가.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, { key = 'futurecastle_message_pre_1', skip = true })

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

	-- 두고 가라니...
	character_util.look_at(sniper, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(sniper, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, { key = 'futurecastle_message_pre_2', skip = true })

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sniper, nil, 'notice')
	-- 뭐야, 너... {0}?
	character_util.remove_emotion(sniper)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, { key = { "futurecastle_message_pre_3", user.Name }, skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 헤에... 살아 있었네. 하긴, 너 정도의 실력자가 그렇게 쉽게 죽진 않겠지.
	character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'doyagao' })
	character_util.nod_twice(sniper)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, { key = 'futurecastle_message_pre_4', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(sniper)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', count = 3, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	-- 그래, 나도 하고싶은 말이 많은데...
	character_util.set_anim(sniper, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, { key = 'futurecastle_message_pre_5', skip = true })

	local sniper_dead = get_character('sniper_dead')
	character_util.set_position(sniper_dead, vector(10,0.5,12))

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_direction(sniper, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(sniper, {name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false, scale = 0.8})
	time_util.mod('attack', 0.3)

	-- 헤카테 씬
	self.wait_sniper = true
	local wait_set = function() self.wait_sniper = false end

	-- 인베이더에게 직격으로 맞는 타이밍
	local temp = vector(15, 0.5, 12)

	character_util.set_anim(sniper_dead, { name = 'run' })

-- 스나이퍼 씬 샷 연출
function local_class:shoot_to_target(start_pos, target, callback, offset)
	local target_pos = target.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0.1, 0.5) + offset
	local bullet_speed = 100
	local effect_scale_ratio = bullet_speed / 30 * 1.1
	local effect_delay_ratio = bullet_speed / 30 * 0.5
	local shoot_dir = (target_pos - start_pos).normalized
	local end_pos = target_pos - shoot_dir * 0.3
	local target_hit_hour = unity_class.vector3.Distance(start_pos, end_pos) / bullet_speed
	local bullet_sprite = self.sniper_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)
			* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	local fx_rotation_2 = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_02' })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		if target_hit_hour > effect_delay_ratio then
			wait_for_sec(target_hit_hour - effect_delay_ratio)
			local smoke_effect =  unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('Manual_AssaultRifle_Sniper_Bullet_SmokeTrail')
												   :Instantiate(bullet_sprite.transform.position, fx_rotation_2, nil)
			smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(effect_scale_ratio, 1, 1)
		else
			local smoke_effect =  unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('Manual_AssaultRifle_Sniper_Bullet_SmokeTrail')
												   :Instantiate(start_pos, fx_rotation_2, nil)
			smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(effect_scale_ratio, 1, 1)
		end
	end))
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			start_pos, end_pos, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)
	if callback ~= nil then
		callback()
	end
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			end_pos, end_pos + shoot_dir * 10, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end

-- 스나이퍼 씬 총알 로드
function local_class:preload_bullet_async()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)
	self.sniper_bullet = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
	local bullet_sprite = self.sniper_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_middle.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then
		return false
	end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'out_start' and not self.saw_start then
		self.saw_start = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sound_play, self, 'sound_1'))
	end

	if zone_name == 'left' or zone_name == 'right' or
			zone_name == 'up' or zone_name == 'down' or zone_name == 'reset' or
			zone_name == 'right_false' or zone_name == 'left_false' then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.labyrinth_move, self, zone_name))
		return true
	end

	-- 한 구역에서 여러 전투 관리하기 위해서 배틀게이트를 수동으로 관리
	if zone_name == 'BATTLE_1' and #self.move_list == 2 and not self.battle_1 then
		self.battle_1 = true
		for i = 1, self.battle_gate_num do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i, true))
		end
		self:active_monster(1, 'enabled')
		for i = 1, self.battle_1_count do
			local battle_monster = get_character('battle_1_' .. i)
			battle_monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
			command_util.execute_monster_notice(battle_monster, user_party_leader, "battle")
		end
	elseif zone_name == 'BATTLE_2' and #self.move_list == 4 and not self.battle_2 then
		self.battle_2 = true
		for i = 1, self.battle_gate_num do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i, true))
		end
		self:active_monster(2, 'enabled')
		for i = 1, self.battle_2_count do
			local battle_monster = get_character('battle_2_' .. i)
			battle_monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
			command_util.execute_monster_notice(battle_monster, user_party_leader, "battle")
		end
	end

	if zone_name == 'sound_1' and not self.sound_1_playing then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sound_play, self, zone_name))
		if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete and self.sfx_sound ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'field', mix = 2})
			self.sfx_sound:Stop(2)
			self.sfx_sound = nil
		end
		return true
	elseif zone_name == 'sound_2' then
		if not self.saw_mid then
			self.saw_start = true
		end
		if not self.sound_2_playing then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sound_play, self, zone_name))
		end
		if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete and self.sfx_sound == nil then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'muted', mix = 2})
			self.sfx_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_exploration_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		end
		return true
	elseif zone_name == 'sound_3' then
		self.sound_1_playing = false
		self.sound_2_playing = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	-- 해당 전투 중복 실행 방지 변수 체크

-- 구역에 따라 목적지에 가까울 수록 커지는 사운드 재생
function local_class:sound_play(zone_name)
	local target_pos
	if zone_name == 'sound_1' then
		self.sound_1_playing = true
		self.sound_2_playing = false
		target_pos = get_field_object('labyrinth_stair').Position
	elseif zone_name == 'sound_2' then
		self.sound_1_playing = false
		self.sound_2_playing = true
		target_pos = get_field_object('in_stair').Position
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local late_time = 2
	-- 부유성 바깥에서의 사운드 처리
	if self.sound_1_playing then
		while self.sound_1_playing do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - user_party.Leader.Position).magnitude

			late_time = 0.3 + 0.05 * diff

			if time_passed >= late_time then
				time_passed = 0

				self.volume = 2

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_beep_02', self.volume)
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		return
	end

	-- 미로에서의 사운드 처리
	if self.sound_2_playing then
		local correct_way_flag = false
		while self.sound_2_playing do
			-- 플레이어 방향이 다음 답 방향과 같으면 볼륨 2, 아니면 0
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local maze_center = vector(47.5,0,-53.5)
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position - maze_center)

			local next_pos = vector_util.to_direction(diff)

			if self.clear_labyrinth then
				correct_way_flag = false

				late_time = 1
				self.volume = 2
			elseif 4 <= diff.magnitude and diff.magnitude < self.labyrinth_size then
				if direction_util.to_str(next_pos) == self.answer_list[#self.move_list + 1] then
					self.volume = 1.5 + 0.1 * diff.magnitude - 0.4
				else
					self.volume = 0
				end
				late_time = 1
				if not correct_way_flag then
					time_passed = late_time
					correct_way_flag = true
				end
			elseif diff.magnitude < 4 then
				correct_way_flag = false

				self.volume = 0
				late_time = 1
			else
				correct_way_flag = false

				self.volume = 2
				late_time = 1
			end

			if time_passed >= late_time then
				time_passed = 0
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_beep_02', self.volume)
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end
		return
	end
end

function local_class:labyrinth_move(zone_name)
	-- 미로를 시작 혹은 포기 하려고 한 경우에는
	if #self.move_list == 0 and zone_name == 'left' or zone_name == 'right_false' then
		if zone_name == 'right_false' then
			self:party_add_position(vector(self.labyrinth_size, 0, 0))
		elseif zone_name == 'left' then
			self:party_add_position(vector(-self.labyrinth_size, 0, 0))
		end
		return
	end

	if zone_name == 'reset' or zone_name == 'left_false' then
		-- 이미 미로를 클리어 한 경우
		if zone_name == 'reset' and self.clear_labyrinth then
			self.move_list = {}
			self.clear_labyrinth = false
			return
		elseif zone_name == 'reset' and not self.clear_labyrinth then
			-- 맨 마지막은 방향이 아니라 reset에서 위치 조정 필요
			if #self.answer_list == #self.move_list + 1 then
				zone_name = 'right'
			else return
			end
		end
		if zone_name == 'left_false' then
			self.move_list = {}
			self.clear_labyrinth = false
			self:party_add_position(vector(-self.labyrinth_size, 0, 0))
			return
		end
	end

	-- 진입한 zone을 list에 추가한다.
	table.insert(self.move_list, zone_name)

	-- 잘못된 길로 갔는지
	local is_fail = false

	-- 올바른 길인지 체크
	local index = #self.move_list
	if self.answer_list[index] ~= self.move_list[index] then
		is_fail = true
	end

	-- 잘못된 길로 갔다면 들렸던 길 초기화
	if is_fail then
		self.move_list = {}
	end

	-- 만약 정답 리스트와 이동한 리스트가 같을 경우(정답일 경우)
	if #self.answer_list == #self.move_list then
		self.clear_labyrinth = true
	end

	-- 아직 클리어를 안했다면
	if not self.clear_labyrinth then
		if zone_name == 'left' then
			self:party_add_position(vector(self.labyrinth_size, 0, 0))
		elseif zone_name == 'right' then
			self:party_add_position(vector(-self.labyrinth_size, 0, 0))
		elseif zone_name == 'up' then
			self:party_add_position(vector(0, 0, -self.labyrinth_size))
		elseif zone_name == 'down' then
			self:party_add_position(vector(0, 0, self.labyrinth_size))
		end

		-- 올바르게 찾았을 경우 몬스터 활성화
		if #self.move_list == 1 and not self.battle_1 then
			self:active_monster(1, 'visible', vector(-self.labyrinth_size, 0, 0))
		elseif #self.move_list == 2 and not self.battle_1 then
			self:active_monster(1, 'visible', vector(self.labyrinth_size, 0, 0))
		elseif #self.move_list == 3 and not self.battle_2 then
			self:active_monster(2, 'visible', vector(0, 0, self.labyrinth_size))
		elseif #self.move_list == 4 and not self.battle_2 then
			self:active_monster(2, 'visible', vector(0, 0, -self.labyrinth_size))
		else
			-- 아닐 경우 비활성화
			self:active_monster(1, 'disabled')
			self:active_monster(2, 'disabled')
		end
	else
		if zone_name == self.answer_list[#self.answer_list] then
			self:party_add_position(vector(self.labyrinth_size, 0, 0))
		end
	end
end

-- 플레이어 파티 이동
-- 파티 따라다니는 followOps를 초기화
-- gird 바로 조정
function local_class:party_add_position(add_pos)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i].Position = user_party[i].Position + add_pos
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.ClearPartyMemberFollowOpsEvent.Instance)
	end

	stage_camera:ResetPositionWithOutGridMove()
end

-- 해당 구역 몬스터 활성화 여부
function local_class:active_monster(battle_count, active_state, move_pos)
	if battle_count == 1 then
		for i = 1, self.battle_1_count do
			local battle_monster = get_character('battle_1_' .. i)
			character_util.set_active_state(battle_monster, active_state)
			if move_pos ~= nil then
				battle_monster.Position = battle_monster.Position + move_pos
			else
				battle_monster.Position = self.original_positions[battle_monster]
			end
		end
	elseif battle_count == 2 then
		for i = 1, self.battle_2_count do
			local battle_monster = get_character('battle_2_' .. i)
			character_util.set_active_state(battle_monster, active_state)
			if move_pos ~= nil then
				battle_monster.Position = battle_monster.Position + move_pos
			else
				battle_monster.Position = self.original_positions[battle_monster]
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.sub_stage_name == stage.Name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	end

	if self.main_stage_name == stage.Name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))

		get_character('sniper').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		self:dispose_bullet()
	end

	if self.sfx_sound ~= nil then
		self.sfx_sound:Stop()
		self.sfx_sound = nil
	end

	self.answer_list = nil
	self.move_list = nil

	self.original_positions = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

-- 서브스테이지용 아이템 이동 연출
function local_class:move_item(item, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	local transform = item.SpriteTransform
	local shadow_transform = item.ShadowTransform
	local shadow_offset = shadow_transform.position - transform.position
	local start_pos = transform.position

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		shadow_transform.position = transform.position + shadow_offset

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 서브스테이지용 아이템 포지션 옮기는 연출
function local_class:set_position_item(item, target_pos)
	local transform = item.SpriteTransform
	local shadow_transform = item.ShadowTransform
	local shadow_offset = shadow_transform.position - transform.position

	transform.position = target_pos
	shadow_transform.position = transform.position + shadow_offset
end

-- 컨베이어벨트 애니메이션 컨트롤
function local_class:work_conveyor_belt(zone_name, turn_on)
	local zone = field:GetZone(zone_name)

	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, zone.Bounds)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if table_util.contain_value(self.belt_gimmick_name, fo.Name) then
			local animator = fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			if turn_on then
				animator:Play('xmas_belt_rolling')
				animator.speed = 3
			else
				animator:Play('empty')
				animator.speed = 1
			end
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:factorio()
	if self.factory_sfx == nil then
		self.factory_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_aircraft_loop_01', loop = true,
														type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default',
														play_pos = field:GetMarker('onigirl_up').position })
	end

	while self.factory_on do

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.factory_routine, self))

		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	if self.factory_sfx ~= nil then
		self.factory_sfx:Stop()
		self.factory_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:factory_routine()
	local empty_potion_id = 20260
	local yellow_potion_id = 20159
	local blue_potion_id = 20249
	local purification_potion_id = 20154
	local box_id = 20175

	local item_ids = {yellow_potion_id, blue_potion_id, purification_potion_id, box_id}

	local potion = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{itemid = empty_potion_id, notforinven = true, pos = vector(99, 0, 99),
			 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})

	local first_pos = field:GetMarker('factory_line_1').position
	self:set_position_item(potion, first_pos)

	local check_points = {}
	local androids = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		check_points[i] = field:GetMarker('working_android_' .. i).position
		androids[i] = get_character('working_android_' .. i)
	end

	for j = 1, 7 do
		if self.factory_on then

			local start_pos = field:GetMarker('factory_line_' .. j).position
			local end_pos = field:GetMarker('factory_line_' .. j + 1).position

			if j == 5 then
				for i = 1, 4 do
					if self.factory_on then

						check_points[i] = vector(check_points[i].x + 1, start_pos.y, start_pos.z)
						yield_return_func(self.move_item, self, potion, check_points[i], (start_pos.x - check_points[i].x) / 2)

						androids[i].SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(0, 0.5, 0.5), 0.5, 0.3)

						yield_return_func(self.move_item, self, potion, check_points[i] + vector(-1, 0, 0), 0.5)

						start_pos = check_points[i] + vector(-1, 0, 0)

						potion:ConsumeComplete()
						potion = drop_item_util.create_item(
								{itemid = item_ids[i], notforinven = true, pos = vector(99, 0, 99),
								 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
						unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(start_pos)

						music_player_util.play_sfx({
							sfx_name = '02_bomb_holdup_fail_02',
							play_pos = androids[i].Position,
							volume = 0.3
						})

						music_player_util.play_sfx({
							sfx_name = '02_wolf_boss_bomb_01',
							play_pos = androids[i].Position,
							volume = 0.3
						})

						self:set_position_item(potion, start_pos)

					end

				end
			end

			if self.factory_on then
				yield_return_func(self.move_item, self, potion, end_pos, unity_class.vector3.Distance(start_pos, end_pos) / 2)
			end

		end

	end

	if not self.is_stay_item then
		potion:ConsumeComplete()
	else
		table.insert(self.stay_item, potion)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

		}

		}

	if state == 'pre' then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			get_character('toy_kid_' .. i).Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_' .. i
		end

		local fifth_kid = get_character('toy_kid_' .. 5)
		fifth_kid.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_5|futurecastle_toy_delivery_5_1'
		fifth_kid.Interactable.RandomTalk = true

	elseif state == 'post' then
		get_character('toy_kid_' .. 1).Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_' .. 17
		get_character('toy_kid_' .. 2).Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_' .. 18
		get_character('toy_kid_' .. 3).Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_' .. 19
		get_character('toy_kid_' .. 4).Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_toy_delivery_' .. 21

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(target, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

	bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
	bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = target.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
	bone_follower:SetBone('[base]weapon' .. slot .. '_side')

	figure.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, rotate)

	table.insert(self.bone_follower_list, bone_follower)
end

	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)

        self:on_interact_event(e)
    end
    return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
    local robot = self.get_robot()

    if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, robot) then
        sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.trio_talk_include_camera_move, self)
    end
end

--endregion

function local_class:setting()
    if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
        if self.quest_progress.Grade ~= 0 then
            local robot = self.get_robot()
            local boss = self.get_boss()
            local panda = self.get_panda()
            local denny = self.get_denny()
            local dir = 'up'
            local pos = self.get_robot_marker().position

            character_util.set_position(robot, pos)
            character_util.set_direction(robot, 'down')
            robot.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
            field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(robot, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

            character_util.set_position(boss, pos + vector(0, 0, -2.5))
            character_util.set_direction(boss, dir)
            boss:HideWeapon(true)

            character_util.set_position(panda, pos + vector(-0.75, 0, -3))
            character_util.set_direction(panda, dir)
            panda:HideWeapon(true)

            character_util.set_position(denny, pos + vector(0.75, 0, -3))
            character_util.set_direction(denny, dir)
            denny:HideWeapon(true)

            self.event_camera_pos = pos
        else
            local interactable_battery = self.get_interactable_battery()
            interactable_battery.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
        end
    end
end

function local_class:trio_talk_include_camera_move()
    if self.beginning_event_played == false then
        camera_util.move_async(self.event_camera_pos, 0.5)
    end
    self:trio_talk()
    camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
    end

function local_class:trio_talk()

    -- 옛 생각을 나게 하는 머신이다. 수명이 다한 것 같다.
    field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'future_castle_trio_0'})

    if self.beginning_event_played == false then
        self.beginning_event_played = true
        local robot_pos = self.get_robot_marker().position

        party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member(robot_pos + vector(-3.5, 0, 0), 'left', 1)
        local robot = self.get_robot()
        local boss = self.get_boss()
        local panda = self.get_panda()
        local denny = self.get_denny()

        -- ...이거 공습을 탈출할 때 여기 놓고 왔었지..
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss, {key = 'future_castle_trio_1', skip = true})

        character_util.set_anim(panda, {name = 'walk'})
        character_util.move_waypoint_async(panda, robot.Position + vector(-self.robot_distance.x + 0.2, 0, -0.25),
                2.5,false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
        character_util.remove_anim(panda)
        wait_for_sec(0.3)
        character_util.set_anim(panda, {name = 'push', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle'})
        wait_for_sec(0.75)
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
        -- 미안 마크-13… 버려두고 가서.
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(panda, {key = 'future_castle_trio_2', skip = true})
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
        character_util.set_anim(panda, {name = 'seat'})
        -- 대니...옛날 그립다…
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(denny, {key = 'future_castle_trio_3', skip = true})
    end

    return true
end

function local_class:remove_battery(looter)
    local target = lua_helper.get_or_default(looter, nil)
    local interactable_battery = self.get_interactable_battery()
    interactable_battery.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

    if self.battery_item ~= nil then
        if target ~= nil then
            self.battery_item.ConsumeTarget = target
            self.battery_item.State = CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.FindLooter
            self.battery_item:Fly()
        else
            self.battery_item:ConsumeComplete()
        end
        self.battery_item = nil
    end
end

return {
    create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
        return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
    end

		end
		return true
	end

function local_class:attack_training_dummy(fo_list, dummy_list)
	local shadow_list = {}

	for i = 1, #dummy_list do
		local dummy = dummy_list[i]
		local shadow = dummy.Transform:GetChild(0)
		table.insert(shadow_list, shadow)
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.4
	local reset_delay = 0.2

	local is_hit = false

	for i = 1, #fo_list do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		if i ~= #fo_list then
			character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'twohand_attack', loop = false, scale = 2.785 })
		end
	end

	local temp_1 = unity_class.time.time
	while (unity_class.time.time - temp_1 < reset_delay) and not self.interrupt_attack do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	while not self.interrupt_attack do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = time_passed / duration
		if progress >= 1 then
			time_passed = 0
			is_hit = false

			for i = 1, #dummy_list do
				local dummy = dummy_list[i]
				local shadow = shadow_list[i]

				dummy.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, 0))
				shadow.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, 0))
			end

			for i = 1, #fo_list do
				local fo = fo_list[i]

				if i ~= #fo_list then
					character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false })
				else
					character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'twohand_attack', loop = false, scale = 2.785 })
				end
			end

			local temp_2 = unity_class.time.time
			while (unity_class.time.time - temp_2 < reset_delay) and not self.interrupt_attack do
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		else
			if not is_hit then
				is_hit = true

				for i = 1, #dummy_list do
					local dummy = dummy_list[i]

					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_dummy_02', parent = dummy,
												 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object', max_distance = 8 })
					self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(dummy.Position)
				end
			end

			progress = time_passed / (duration * 0.75)

			local angle = -18 * unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.Min(1, progress) * unity_class.mathf.PI)

			for i = 1, #dummy_list do
				local dummy = dummy_list[i]
				local shadow = shadow_list[i]

				dummy.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, vector(0, 0, 1))
				shadow.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-angle, vector(0, 0, 1))
			end

			if progress >= 0.8 then
				for i = 1, #fo_list do
					local fo = fo_list[i]

					if i ~= #fo_list then
						character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'sword_idle' })
					else
						character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'idle' })
					end
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #fo_list do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		if i ~= #fo_list then
			character_util.remove_anim(fo)
		end
	end

	self.training_coroutine = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	self.female_ghost.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)

function local_class:load_resource()
