function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	local quest_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('QuestData')
	self.quest_spec = quest_data:GetQuest(self.quest_id)
	self.quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

	-- 스테이지만 오픈되고 퀘스트가 진행되지 않은 경우 강제로 진행시켜준다.
	if user_progress:IsStageOpened("substage_1_15") then
		if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
			if self.quest_progress == nil then
				self.quest_progress = CS.Oak.QuestProgress(self.quest_spec, 0, -1)
				yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.StartQuest, self.cs_controller, self.quest_progress)
			end

			coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_quest(self.quest_progress, 1))

			coroutine.yield(music_player:PreloadMusic(CS.Oak.IEventControllerExtensions.GetMusicList(self.cs_controller)))
		end
	end

	self.scene:add_callback('RemoveGhostGuards', { controller = self, func = self.remove_ghost_guards } )
	self.scene:add_callback('GhostJumpDown', { controller = self, func = self.ghost_jump_down } )
	self.scene:add_callback('FemaleGhostFadeIn', { controller = self, func = self.female_ghost_fadein } )

	self.alter = get_field_object("ghost_alter")

	if stage.Name == "easy_forest_2_5" then
		self.event_orc = get_character("event_orc")
		character_util.set_active_state(self.event_orc, "disabled")
		self.grave = get_field_object("ghost_guard_grave")
		self.substage_map = get_field_object("substage_1_15").FieldObjectBehaviour

		if user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.quest_id) then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.female_ghost, "disabled")
			character_util.set_active_state(self.male_ghost, "disabled")
			self.grave.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end
	else
		self.ghost_guard_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		for i = 1, self.ghost_guard_num do
			local cur_ghost = get_character(string.format("ghost_guard_%d", i))
			self.ghost_guard_list:Add(cur_ghost)
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(self.female_ghost, "disabled")

		if user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.quest_id) then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.male_ghost, "disabled")
			self.alter.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			self:remove_ghost_guards()
		elseif self.quest_progress ~= nil then
			local char_pos, marker_pos, quest_tracker_text

			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
				self.female_ghost.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
				char_pos = vector(50, 0,54.5)
				marker_pos = vector(26.5, 0, 23.5)
				quest_tracker_text = "ghost_guard_tracker_0"
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
				char_pos = vector(50, 0, 54.5)
				marker_pos = vector(26.5, 0, 23.5)
				quest_tracker_text = "ghost_guard_tracker_1"
			else
				char_pos = vector(27.5, 0, 26.5)
				marker_pos = vector(110, 0, 54.5)
				quest_tracker_text = "ghost_guard_tracker_0"
			end

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint("ghost_guard", self.quest_id,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker_pos)
			character_util.set_position(self.female_ghost, char_pos)
			quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(quest_tracker_text))
		end
	end

	self.scene:setting()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.quest_id) then
		if stage.Name == 'substage_1_15' and event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("last_door", true))
		end
		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) then
		self:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)

	if stage.Name == "easy_forest_2_5" then
		if self.quest_progress == nil then
			CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestNotice(self.female_ghost)
		else
			CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestAccepted(self.female_ghost)
		end

		self:set_reward_sword()
	else
		if not user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.quest_id) and self.quest_progress ~= nil then
			self:set_reward_sword()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_reward_sword()
	self. reward_sword = drop_item_util.create_item( { pos = {self.alter.Position.x + 0.1, 0.75, self.alter.Position.z + 0.2},
			itemid = self.reward_sword_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter", showoncharacter = true})
	transform_util.sprite_rotation(self.reward_sword, {30, 0, -135})
	transform_util.shadow_rotation(self.reward_sword, vector(30, 0, -135))
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

	if not e.FullEnter then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	if self.quest_progress == nil then return end


	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == "appear_ghost" then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.fade_ghost, self, self.female_ghost, 1.5, true))
	elseif zone_name == "forest_treasure_entrance" then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.start_infiltration, self))
		end
	elseif string.find(zone_name, "ghost_guard_remove_marker") then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("ghost_guard")
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	if self.quest_progress == nil then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == "apper_ghost" then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.fade_ghost, self, self.female_ghost, 1.5, false))
	end
	if zone_name == "ghost_guard_remove_marker" then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint("ghost_guard", self.quest_id,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(26.5, 0, 23.5))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if e.Target == self.grave then
		if self.quest_progress == nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.request_ghost_guard, self))
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.female_ghost, "ghost_guard_script_0")
		end
	elseif e.Target == self.alter then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == "discovered" then
		if not self.check_detected then
			local detecter = get_character(e.Params[1])
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.detected_by_ghostguard, self, detecter))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:request_ghost_guard()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.RemoveIcon(self.female_ghost)

	character_util.align_party(vector(self.female_ghost.Position.x, 0, self.female_ghost.Position.z),
			"left", 1, "arc")

	coroutine.yield(self:fade_ghost(self.female_ghost, 1.5, true))

	if not self.skip_request then
		coroutine.yield(self.scene:request_ghost())
	end

	self.skip_request = true

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_id, false)

	if accepted then
		self.quest_progress = CS.Oak.QuestProgress(self.quest_spec, 0, -1)
		coroutine.yield(quest_util.start_quest(self.quest_progress))

		coroutine.yield(self.substage_map:OpenStage())
		coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_quest(self.quest_progress, 1))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestAcceptEvent())
		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestAccepted(self.female_ghost)
	else
		self.quest_progress = nil
		CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestNotice(self.female_ghost)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestDeclineEvent())
	end

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
end

function local_class:start_infiltration()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("ghost_guard")
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	self.female_ghost.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.female_ghost, "enabled")
	coroutine.yield(self:fade_ghost(self.female_ghost, 1.5, true))
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))
	coroutine.yield(self.scene:start_infiltration())
	coroutine.yield(self:fade_ghost(self.female_ghost, 1.5, false))
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))
	coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_quest(self.quest_progress, 1))
	character_util.set_active_state(self.female_ghost, "disabled")
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint("ghost_guard", self.quest_id, false, vector(110, 0, 54.5))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString("ghost_guard_tracker_0"))

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:detected_by_ghostguard(detecter)
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	self.check_detected = true

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_ghost_detect_01")

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

	--character_util.stop(detecter)
	for i=0, self.ghost_guard_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.stop(self.ghost_guard_list[i])
	end
	character_util.stop(self.male_ghost)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(detecter, "ghost_guard_script_1")
	character_util.set_anim(detecter, {name = "release"})
	character_util.set_emotion(detecter, {name = "attack"})

	for i=0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = "embarrassed"})
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = "tired"})
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_fade_out_01")

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	local basepos = unity_class.vector3.zero

	if detecter.Transform.name == "ghost_guard_1" or detecter.Transform.name == "ghost_guard_2" then
		basepos = stage.Field:GetMarker("ghost_checkpoint1").position
	elseif detecter.Transform.name == "ghost_guard_3" or detecter.Transform.name == "ghost_guard_4" then
		basepos = stage.Field:GetMarker("ghost_checkpoint2").position
	else
		basepos = stage.Field:GetMarker("ghost_checkpoint3").position
	end

	local poslist = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	poslist:Add(basepos)
	poslist:Add(basepos + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	poslist:Add(basepos + vector(-1, 0, 1))
	poslist:Add(basepos + vector(-1, 0, -1))

	for i=0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], poslist[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], "right")
		user_party[i]:RemoveAnimation()
		user_party[i]:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	detecter:RemoveAnimation()
	detecter:RemoveEmotion()

	for i=0, self.ghost_guard_list.Count - 1 do
		self.ghost_guard_list[i]:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	end
	--detecter:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	self.male_ghost:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	self.check_detected = false

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:ending()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	self.check_detected = true

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	self.male_ghost.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	character_util.stop(self.male_ghost)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("ghost_guard")
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	self.alter.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.reward_sword.ConsumeTarget = user_party_leader
	self.reward_sword.State = CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.FindLooter
	self.reward_sword:Fly()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	local item_placeholder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
	item_placeholder.ItemId = self.reward_sword_id
	item_placeholder.NotForInventory = true

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local item_target_pos = vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, user_party_leader.Position.y + 1.2,
	user_party_leader.Position.z - 0.1)


	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_get_keyitem_01")
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, "down")
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "get"})

	local item = CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(user_party_leader.Position, item_placeholder)
	item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
	item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

	item.State = CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.DontFindLooter
	item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	item:SetSortingLayer(true)

	stage_camera:ResizeTo(3.5, 0.5)
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.1)
	local hightlighteffect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_highlight_item"):Instantiate(item_target_pos);

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = "smile", loop = false})

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < 1.5 do
		local curpos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(user_party_leader.Position, item_target_pos,
				(unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / 1.5)
		item:SetPosition(curpos)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	hightlighteffect:Dispose()
	item.ConsumeTarget = nil
	item:ConsumeComplete()

	stage_camera:ResizeTo(CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize, 0.25)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, "none")
	user_party_leader:RemoveAnimation()
	user_party_leader:RemoveEmotion()

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:ending())

	coroutine.yield(self:fade_ghost(self.female_ghost, 1.5, false))
	coroutine.yield(self:fade_ghost(self.male_ghost, 1.5, false))

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

	character_util.set_active_state(self.female_ghost, "disabled")
	character_util.set_active_state(self.male_ghost, "disabled")

	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 0.5)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	self.check_detected = false

	local undisplay_reward = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)
	undisplay_reward:Add(self.reward_sword_id)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("last_door", false))

	CS.Oak.User.Me:Updated("+", self.user_updated)

	quest_util.complete_quest(self, 0, true, true,
	false, true, undisplay_reward)

	--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	CS.Oak.User.Me:Updated("-", self.user_updated)

	self.reward_item = rewardItem or nil
	if self.reward_item == nil then return end

	-- 검을 장착할 수 없는 캐릭터도 추천이 뜨고있어서 추천 띄우는 코드 주석 처리
	--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSEvent.Create(CS.Oak.SNSEquip.Create(user_party_leader, self.reward_item,
	--CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, false, true)))
end

function local_class:user_updated()
	local user = CS.Oak.User.Me
	local weaponlist = user:GetItemListByType(CS.Oak.ItemType.Weapon)
	rewardItem = weaponlist[weaponlist.Count - 1]
end

function local_class:remove_ghost_guards()
	for i=0, self.ghost_guard_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.stop(self.ghost_guard_list[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(self.ghost_guard_list[i], "disabled")
	end
end

function local_class:fade_ghost(fc, fadetime, fadein)
	if fadein then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_ghost_appear_01")
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerLookAtState.Create(fc, user_party_leader)
		fc:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	else
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_ghost_disappear_01")
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if fadein then
		fc.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(1, fadetime)
	else
		fc.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(0, fadetime)
		fc:OnEvent(CS.OakStateResetEvent.Instance)
	end
end

function local_class:ghost_jump_down()
	local curtime = unity_class.time.time
	local jumptime = 0.5
	local curpos = self.female_ghost.Position
	local targetx = 86.5
	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(jumptime, 2, 0);

	while unity_class.time.time - curtime < jumptime do
		local curx = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Lerp(curpos.x, targetx, (unity_class.time.time - curtime) / jumptime)
		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local disty = freefall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(self.female_ghost, vector(curx, curpos.y + disty, curpos.z))
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.female_ghost, {name = "release", loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.female_ghost, {name = "smile", loop = false})

	character_util.set_anim(self.male_ghost, {name = "embarrassed", loop = false})
	character_util.jump(self.male_ghost, 0.4, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	self.female_ghost:RemoveAnimation()
	self.male_ghost:RemoveAnimation()
end

function local_class:female_ghost_fadein()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.fade_ghost, self, self.female_ghost, 1.5, true))
end


function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.reward_item = nil
	self.event_orc = nil
	self.grave = nil
	self.substage_map = nil
	self.male_ghost = nil
	self.female_ghost = nil
	self.reward_sword = nil
	rewardItem = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('GirlInRed_controller')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = GirlInRed @
		Comment = 스팀펑크 서브스테이지 빨간 머리띠를 한 소녀 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.stage_name = 'substage_9_2'

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	-- 플레이어가 폐광산에 진입하면 쥐들이 움직이기 시작. 보다 자연스러운 연출을 위해 2개의 코루틴으로 분리
	self.move_rat_routine_1 = nil
	self.move_rat_routine_2 = nil

	self.scene_5_zone_entered = false

	self.talked_to_refugee_girl = false

	-- 수용민 가족이 숨어있는 보물상자를 열었는지 체크
	self.opened_refugee_chest = false

	-- 수용민 가족 보물상자 이벤트 선택 결과 저장
	self.promised_refugee_IOU = 'promised_refugee_IOU'

	-- 수용민 가족에게 보상 받았는지 여부 저장
	self.received_gift = false
	self.received_refugee_gift = 'received_refugee_gift'

	self.request_stage_name = 'steampunk_1_3'

	self.main_quest_id = 91
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

		get_field_object('item_wall').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		get_field_object('gift_wall').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	-- pre story section 은 여기서 읽는다
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'GirlInRedPreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'GirlInRedSection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'GirlInRedSection2'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'GirlInRedSection3'),
	}
	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'GirlInRedPostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	-- -- 3스테이지 메인퀘스트 이벤트를 다 보고나서 재입장한 상태라면
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
	if main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.InnerProgress >= 12 then
		quest_icon.PreLoad()
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		coroutine.yield(unity_object_pool.WaitAll())
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		local refugee_chest = get_field_object('refugee_chest')

		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
			if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
				return false
			end

			if e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_1' or e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_2' then
				if self.move_rat_routine_1 ~= nil and self.move_rat_routine_2 ~= nil then
					stop_coroutine(self.move_rat_routine_1)
					self.move_rat_routine_1 = nil
					stop_coroutine(self.move_rat_routine_2)
					self.move_rat_routine_2 = nil
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_5' and not self.scene_5_zone_entered then
				if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
					self.scene_5_zone_entered = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.white_rat, self))

					return true
				end
			end
		end

		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
			if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
				return false
			end

			if e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_1' or e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_2' then
				if self.move_rat_routine_1 == nil and self.move_rat_routine_2 == nil then
					self.move_rat_routine_1 = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.move_rat_1, self))
					self.move_rat_routine_2 = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.move_rat_2, self))
				end
			end
		end

		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent) then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, refugee_chest) and not self.opened_refugee_chest then
				if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
					self.opened_refugee_chest = true
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.open_refugee_chest, self)

					return true
				else
					self.opened_refugee_chest = true
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.open_refugee_chest_later, self)

					return true
				end
			end
		end

		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
			if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
				return false
			end

			if e.CameraGrid.name == 'grid_cave' then
				if self.move_rat_routine_1 == nil and self.move_rat_routine_2 == nil then
					self.move_rat_routine_1 = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.move_rat_1, self))
					self.move_rat_routine_2 = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.move_rat_2, self))
				end
			else
				if self.move_rat_routine_1 ~= nil and self.move_rat_routine_2 ~= nil then
					stop_coroutine(self.move_rat_routine_1)
					self.move_rat_routine_1 = nil
					stop_coroutine(self.move_rat_routine_2)
					self.move_rat_routine_2 = nil
				end
			end
		end

		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
			local rats = {}

			for i = 1, 15 do
				table.insert(rats, get_character('rat_' .. i))
			end

			for i = 1, 15 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(rats[i], e.Info.target) then
					local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
					if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.None
						damage_info.sender = user_party.Leader
						damage_info.target = rats[i]
						damage_info.damage = 1000

						command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('gift_wall')) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pick_up_gift, self)
				return true
			end

			if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('refugee_girl')) and self.talked_to_refugee_girl == false then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_to_refugee_girl, self)
					return true
				elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('item_wall')) then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.read_letter, self)
					return true
				elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('scene_4_hole')) then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_recurring, self))
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		-- 수용민 가족
		local refugees = {}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			table.insert(refugees, get_character('refugee_family_' .. i))
			refugees[i].SpineController:AddColor(refugees[i].Name, unity_color({ 0.5, 0.3, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
		end

		-- 수용민 가족이 숨어있는 보물상자
		local refugee_chest = get_field_object('refugee_chest')

		-- 가족의 레벨 UI 미표시 및 보물상자 위로 캐릭터 삐져나오지 않게 수그리기
		for i = 1, #refugees do
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(refugees[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

			-- 가족이 숨은 사실을 모르는 척 해달라는 부탁을 들어줬으면 웃는 상태로 시작
			if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.promised_refugee_IOU) == 1 then
				character_util.set_emotion(refugees[i], { name = 'smile' })

				-- “꼭 여기로 다시 찾아오거라!”
				if i == 2 then
					refugees[i].Interactable.Talk = 'girl_in_red_s2_28'
				end

				-- 가족의 부탁을 거절했거나 TreasureBox를 열었는데 CustomState가 저장이 되지 않은 상태라면
			elseif self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.promised_refugee_IOU) == 2 or
					(self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.promised_refugee_IOU) == -1 and stage_progress:IsBoxOpened('refugee_chest') == true) then
				refugees[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

			-- 상자를 아직 열지 않았다면 가족이 상자 안에 수그리고 떨고있게
			else
				character_util.shake(refugees[i], 0.02, 1991)
				character_util.set_emotion(refugees[i], { name = 'tired' })
				if i == 3 then
					character_util.set_anim(refugees[i], { name = 'frustration', loop = false })
				else
					character_util.set_anim(refugees[i], { name = 'meditation' })
				end
			end
		end

		-- CustomState에 따라 상자 상태 변경
		-- 가족이 숨은 사실을 모르는 척 해달라는 부탁을 들어줬으면
		if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.promised_refugee_IOU) == 1 then
			refugee_chest.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		-- 가족의 부탁을 거절했으면
		elseif self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.promised_refugee_IOU) == 2 then
			refugee_chest.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

			-- 가족의 부탁을 거절한 직후 상자를 뒤져보지 않았다면, 금반지 획득할 수 있도록 투명 벽을 보물상자 위치로 이동
			if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.received_refugee_gift) == -1 then
				local gift = get_field_object('gift_wall')
				gift.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				gift.Position = vector(-31.5, 0, -23)
				gift.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			end
		-- CustomState가 세팅되지 않은 상태(선택지를 선택하지 않은 상태)라면
		else
			-- 선택지가 저장되어 있지 않았는데 박스가 열려 있는 상태이면서 아이템을 획득하지 못한 상태라면 문제가 생긴 상황.
			-- 아이템을 획득할 수 있도록 CustomState 2번과 같은 상태로 만들어 준다.
			if stage_progress:IsBoxOpened('refugee_chest') == true and self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.received_refugee_gift) == -1 then
				refugee_chest.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

				local gift = get_field_object('gift_wall')
				gift.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				gift.Position = vector(-31.5, 0, -23)
				gift.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			end
		end

		-- 섹션 2 or 섹션 3일 때 페니로 플레이 시작
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
			if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
				-- 쥐들과의 전투 시 BGM을 변경하지 않는다.
				music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })

				if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
						screen_util.fade_out_circular(0, screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))
					end))
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
						local penny = get_character('penny')
						--self:set_manual_character_level(penny, user_party_leader)
						if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, penny) == false then
							screen_util.fade_out_circular(0, screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))
							-- 리더를 제외한 파티 멤버는 빼준다.
							for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
								character_util.set_position(user_party[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
								character_util.convert_to_npc(user_party[i])
							end
							-- 페니로 변경
							local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
							param.HidePreviousParty = false
							character_util.convert_to_manual_character(penny, param)
							character_util.set_position(penny, user_party_leader.Position)
							character_util.set_direction(penny, 'right')
							character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(-999, 0, -999))
							screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))
						end
						user_party:ResetControllers()
						field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)
					end))
				end
				-- 서브스테이지 클리어 이후 포스트 섹션
			else
				-- 제국병들
				local soldiers = {}
				for i = 1, 8 do
					table.insert(soldiers, get_character('soldier_' .. i))
					soldiers[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				end

				-- 제국 정찰병들
				local patrols = {}
				for i = 1, 6 do
					table.insert(patrols, get_character('soldier_patrol_' .. i))
					character_util.stop(patrols[i])
					patrols[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				end

				-- 제국병 소년단원
				local soldier_boy = get_character('soldier_boy')
				soldier_boy.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

				-- 제국병 소녀단원
				local soldier_girl = get_character('soldier_girl')
				soldier_girl.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

				-- 수용민들
				local refugees = {}
				for i = 1, 6 do
					table.insert(refugees, get_character('refugee_' .. i))
					refugees[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				end

				-- 쓰레기통 소녀
				local refugee_girl = get_character('refugee_girl')

				if refugee_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
					refugee_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
				end

				character_util.set_anim(refugee_girl, { name = 'seat' })
				character_util.set_emotion(refugee_girl, { name = 'scared' })
				character_util.shake(refugee_girl, 0.02, 999)

				-- 폐광산 쥐 떼
				local rats = {}
				for i = 1, 15 do
					table.insert(rats, get_character('rat_' .. i))
					rats[i].SpineController:Scale(vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), 0)
				end

				rats[3].Position = vector(-10, 0, -76)
				character_util.set_direction(rats[3], 'down')

				-- 씬#3 푸쉬 블럭, 스위치 및 남쪽 문 제거
				local push_block = get_field_object('scene_3_pushable_block')
				push_block.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				local switch = get_field_object('scene_3_door_switch_bottom')
				switch.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				local door_left = get_field_object('scene_3_door_bottom_left')
				local door_right = get_field_object('scene_3_door_bottom_right')
				door_left.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				door_right.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('scene_3_door_bottom_left', false))
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('scene_3_door_bottom_right', false))

				-- 스테이지 메인 퀘스트를 전부 완료했으면 clear_flag를 페니 집 안에 세팅
				local clear_flag = get_field_object('clear_flag')
				clear_flag.Position = vector(28, 0, -1)

				-- 보물상자에 숨어있던 가족
				local refugee_family = {}
				for i = 1, 3 do
					table.insert(refugee_family, get_character('refugee_family_' .. i))
				end

				-- 가족은 떠나고 상자에는 부탁에 대한 선택에 따라 편지+선물 증정 여부가 결정된다
				for i = 1, #refugee_family do
					refugee_family[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				end

				-- 부탁을 들어줬으면 편지 드롭
				if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.promised_refugee_IOU) == 1 then
					local letter_id = 20167
					local drop_position = vector(-31.5, 0.5, -23)
					local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
							{ pos = drop_position, itemid = letter_id,
							  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })

					-- Interactable 달아줄 투명 벽 생성
					local item = get_field_object('item_wall')
					item.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
					item.Position = vector(-31.5, 0, -23)
					item.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 플레이할 캐릭터 레벨 정보 다른 캐릭터(시작할 때 가져온 리더)에 맞추는 함수
-- target_character : 목표 레벨을 가지고 있는 캐릭터(보통은 user_party_leader)
-- manual_character : 매뉴얼 캐릭터로 바꿀 npc
function local_class:set_manual_character_level(manual_character, target_character)
	if target_character == nil then
		target_character = user_party_leader
	end

	local exp = target_character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Exp
	manual_character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(exp)
end

function local_class:talk_to_refugee_girl()
	-- 플레이어 좌측 서클 정렬
	party_util.align_party(vector(1.5, 0, -31), 'left', 1.5, 'arc')

	-- 쓰레기통 소녀
	local refugee_girl = get_character('refugee_girl')

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(refugee_girl, nil, 'question')

	-- 누구...세요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_20', skip = true})

	-- 나쁜 사람... 아니죠?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_21', skip = true})

	-- 나쁜 사람들은 다 갔나요...?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_21_1', skip = true})

	-- 선택지: [응, 이제 나와도 돼!] / [조금만 더 숨어있으렴.]
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'girl_in_red_s2_21_2', 'mercy' }, { 'girl_in_red_s2_21_3', 'intellect' } }, 'release')

	if choose_result == 1 then
		self.talked_to_refugee_girl = true

		-- 믿어도 되죠?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_21_4', skip = true})

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(refugee_girl, 0, 0.1)

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		-- 소녀가 쓰레기통에서 빠져 나온다.
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')

		character_util.remove_anim(refugee_girl)
		character_util.move_to(refugee_girl, vector(2, 0, -31), 0.3, nil, true, false)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(refugee_girl, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.mario_jump_async(refugee_girl, 'left')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 두리번거린다.
		character_util.set_direction(refugee_girl, 'down')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.set_direction(refugee_girl, 'up')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.set_direction(refugee_girl, 'left')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.stop_shake(refugee_girl)
		character_util.set_emotion(refugee_girl, {name = 'smile'})

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

		character_util.set_anim(refugee_girl, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false})

		wait_for_sec(2)

		character_util.set_emotion(refugee_girl, {name = 'tired'})
		character_util.remove_anim(refugee_girl)

		-- 휴.. 숨막혀 죽는 줄 알았어요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugee_girl, {key = 'girl_in_red_s2_22', skip = true})

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_emotion(refugee_girl)

		refugee_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		refugee_girl.Interactable.Talk = 'girl_in_red_s2_22'
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

		character_util.show_emoticon(refugee_girl, nil, 'annoyed')
	end
end

function local_class:read_letter()
	-- 저번엔 고마웠다 꼬마야. 덕분에 무사히 탈출할 수 있었단다.
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
	coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString('girl_in_red_s2_31'), 0, 1))
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 네게 도움이 될지 모르겠지만 고마움의 표시니까 사양하지 말거라.
	-- - 캔터베리 가족 일동
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
	coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString('girl_in_red_s2_32'), 0, 1))
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 보상 증정: 최초 1회
	if not self.received_gift and self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.received_refugee_gift) == -1 then
		self.received_gift = true
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.received_refugee_gift, 1)

		-- 수용민 가족이 보상으로 주는 금반지를 획득한다.
		local item = {}
		item.ItemId = 9110022
		item.Level = 49
		item.NotForInventory = true
		item.SkipItemGetText = true

		local drop_position = vector(-31.5, 0.5, -23)
		local target_position = vector(-32.5, 0, -25)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_equip_weapon_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

		local drop_item = CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(drop_position, target_position,
			item, true, false, CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.FindLooter)

		drop_item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

		wait_for_sec(1)

		drop_item:Fly()

		-- 실제 인벤토리 아이템 획득 처리
		local refugee_gift = get_field_object('refugee_gift')
		message_system:SendSync(refugee_gift, CS.Oak.InteractEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, refugee_gift))
	end
end

function local_class:pick_up_gift()
	if not self.received_gift and self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.received_refugee_gift) == -1 then
		self.received_gift = true
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.received_refugee_gift, 1)

		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')

		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'eat'})

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

		-- 무언가 손에 잡히는 것 같다.
		stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
		coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString('girl_in_red_s2_33'), 0, 1))
		stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 난민 가족의 부탁을 거절했어도 금반지를 획득한다.
		local item = {}
		item.ItemId = 9110022
		item.Level = 49
		item.NotForInventory = true
		item.SkipItemGetText = true

		local drop_position = vector(-31.5, 0.5, -23)
		local target_position = vector(-32.5, 0, -25)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_equip_weapon_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

		local drop_item = CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(drop_position, target_position,
			item, true, false, CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.FindLooter)

		drop_item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

		wait_for_sec(1)

		drop_item:Fly()

		-- 실제 인벤토리 아이템 획득 처리: 페니가 아닌 유저가 획득하도록 처리
		local refugee_gift = get_field_object('refugee_gift')

		local penny = get_character('penny')
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, penny) == false then
			message_system:SendSync(refugee_gift, CS.Oak.InteractEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, refugee_gift))
		else
			message_system:SendSync(refugee_gift, CS.Oak.InteractEvent.Create(user_party_leader, refugee_gift))
		end

		-- 반지 획득 후 인터랙터블 투명 벽 제거
		local gift = get_field_object('gift_wall')
		gift.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		gift.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:fall_recurring()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local hole = get_field_object('scene_4_hole')

	-- 페니, 구멍으로 떨어진다.
	yield_return(self, 'fall_into_hole_routine', hole.Position)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

    screen_util.fade_out_circular(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	-- 페니, 폐광 바닥으로 추락
    local marker = field:GetMarker('cave_floor')
    yield_return(self, 'land_on_routine', marker.position, marker.direction)
end

-- 구멍에 Interact해서 특정 위치로 떨어지는 이벤트
function local_class:fall_into_hole_routine(pos)
    music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        user_party[i].SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.zero, 1)
        user_party[i].SpineController:Jump(2, 1)

        character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'get'})

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(user_party[i], pos + vector(0, -1, 0), 0.5, nil, true))

-- 구멍에 Interact해서 특정 위치와 방향으로 착지하는 이벤트
function local_class:land_on_routine(pos, dir)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	camera_util.move(pos, 0.1)

    screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

    local fall_time = 1
    local bounce_time = 0.5

    local fall_party_delay = fall_time / user_party.Count
    local bounce_party_delay = bounce_time / user_party.Count

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        user_party[i].SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

        character_util.set_position(user_party[i], pos + vector(1.5 - i, 15, 0))
        character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], dir)
        character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'embarrassed'})
        character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'damaged'})

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(self.freefall_character, self, user_party[i], fall_time))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(fall_party_delay))
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

			user_party[i].SpineController:Jump(1, bounce_time)

			character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'prostrate'})

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(bounce_time))

			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

			character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'confused'})

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2))

			-- 플레이어 일어남
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.shake(user_party[i], 0.05, 1)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
			character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'get'})
			character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
			character_util.normal_jump_async(user_party[i])
			character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
		end))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(fall_party_delay))
    end

	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 카메라 다시 플레이어에게로
	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	-- UI를 표시한다.
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 플레이어가 컨트롤을 되찾는다.
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 일정 시간 동안 자유낙하하는 캐릭터 연출
function local_class:freefall_character(character, fall_time)
    local curtime = unity_class.time.time
    local falltime = fall_time
    local curpos = character.Position
    local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(falltime, curpos.y, 0);

    while unity_class.time.time - curtime < falltime do
        freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
        local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

        character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, curpos.y + dist_y, curpos.z), true)
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, 0, curpos.z))
end

		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.received_refugee_gift, 1)

		item.NotForInventory = true
		item.SkipItemGetText = true

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil

		local refugee_girl = get_character('refugee_girl')

		refugee_chest.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
end

		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.item_list ~= nil then
		for _, v in pairs(self.item_list) do
			v:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.item_list = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_female()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_female, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, {
		self.get_armor_piece(1),
		self.get_armor_piece(2),
		self.get_armor_piece(3),
		self.get_armor_piece(4),
		self.get_armor_piece(5),
		self.get_armor_piece(6),
		self.get_armor_piece(7),
		self.get_armor_piece(8),

function local_class:talk_with_female()
	local female = self.get_female()

	if type_util.is_npc_interactable(female) then
		female.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	character_util.set_direction(female, 'left')

local local_class = newclass('goblinthiefnew_controller')

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, scene)
	-- CS Controller 로 OnEvent 를 받을수 있다.
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.end_quest_started = false

	self.scene = scene()

	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.PreLoad()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	self.kid_girl = get_character('kid_girl')
	self.kid_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	self.goblin_thief = get_character('goblin_thief_3')
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.goblin_thief)
	self.goblin_thief.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.goblin_group_battle_end = false

	self.is_in_zone = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource_routine, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	local quest_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('QuestData')
	self.quest_spec = quest_data:GetQuest(self.quest_id)
	self.quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

	-- lua 에서는 클래스 객체는 self 를 같이 보내 줘야함
	self.scene:add_callback('ThrowBag', { controller = self, func = self.throw_bag } )

	self.scene:setting()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) then
		self:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		self:on_item_get_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'goblin_thief' then
		local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ItemData')
		local item_place_holder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
		item_place_holder.ItemId = item_data:GetSpec('goblin_thief_bag').Id
		item_place_holder.NotForInventory = true
		CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(self.goblin_thief.Position, self.goblin_thief.Position, item_place_holder, true)
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('goblin_thief')
	end

	if e.BattleGroupName == 'goblin_thief_event' then
		self.goblin_group_battle_end = true

		if self.is_bag_item_get then
			start_coroutine(self.on_get_bag, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target
	local kid_girl = self.kid_girl
	local quest_spec = self.quest_spec
	local quest_progress = self.quest_progress
	local inner_progress = 0
	if quest_progress ~= nil then inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress end
	local cm = coroutine_manager

	if target ~= kid_girl then return end

	if user_progress:ClearedQuest(quest_spec.QuestId) then
		local speech_data = speech_bubble.generate_param(kid_girl, game_string:GetString('goblin_thief_script_0'))
		cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, speech_bubble.instance:ShowSpeechBubbleAsync(speech_data))
	elseif quest_progress ~= nil and inner_progress == 0 then
		local speech_data = speech_bubble.generate_param(kid_girl, game_string:GetString('goblinthief_2'))
		cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, speech_bubble.instance:ShowSpeechBubbleAsync(speech_data))
	elseif quest_progress ~= nil and inner_progress == 1 and self.end_quest_started == false then
		self.end_quest_started = true
		cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_end, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if self.quest_progress == nil then return end

	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ItemData")
	if e.Item.ItemId == item_data:GetSpec('goblin_thief_bag').Id and e.Getter == user_party_leader then
		self.is_bag_item_get = true

		if self.goblin_group_battle_end then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.on_get_bag, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_in_zone and (e.FullEnter == true and
			e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and
			e.Zone.Name == 'goblin_thief_start' and self.quest_progress == nil) then
		self.is_in_zone = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_start, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	local need_setup_goblin = true
	local quest_progress = self.quest_progress
	local inner_progress = quest_progress == nil and 0 or quest_progress.InnerProgress

	local is_complete = false
	if quest_progress ~= nil then is_complete = quest_progress.IsComplete end

	if quest_progress ~= nil then
		if inner_progress >= 1 or is_complete then
			need_setup_goblin = false
			self.goblin_thief.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			field_object_util.set_active_state(get_character('goblin_thief_1'), active_state_type.disabled)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(get_character('goblin_thief_2'), active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		if inner_progress == 0 then
			local initPos = stage.Field:GetMarker('goblin_thief_0_0').position
			self.goblin_thief.Position = initPos

			character_util.convert_to_monster(self.goblin_thief, 'goblin_thief')
			self.goblin_thief.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end

		if is_complete == true then
			self.kid_girl:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('victory_extra', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))
		elseif inner_progress == 0 then
			self.kid_girl:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('embarrassed', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))
			self:mark_goblin_thief()
		elseif inner_progress == 1 then
			self.kid_girl:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('victory_extra', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))
			self:mark_kid_girl()
		end

		self.kid_girl.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	else
		self.goblin_thief.Position = self.kid_girl.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
		self.goblin_thief.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	end

	if need_setup_goblin == true and self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		local aiStageChangeEvent = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.AIGoblinThiefState(self.goblin_thief))
		message_system:SendSync(self.goblin_thief, aiStageChangeEvent)
	end

	if quest_progress == nil or is_complete == true then
		return
	end

	if inner_progress == 0 then
		CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestAccepted(self.kid_girl)
	elseif inner_progress == 1 then
		CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestCleared(self.kid_girl)
	end
end

function local_class:quest_start()
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('goblin_thief')
	stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	self.scene:quest_start()

	character_util.convert_to_monster(self.goblin_thief, 'goblin_thief')
	self.goblin_thief.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local stage_change = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.AIGoblinThiefState(self.goblin_thief))

	message_system:SendSync(self.goblin_thief, stage_change)

	self.quest_progress = CS.Oak.QuestProgress(self.quest_spec, 0, -1)
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.StartQuest(nil, self.quest_progress))

	self.goblin_thief.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestAccepted(self.kid_girl)

	self:mark_goblin_thief()
end

function local_class:mark_goblin_thief()
	-- 크래시리틱스에 goblin_thief 키 중복 AddQuestMarkerToIFO 가 수집되어 방어적으로 넣음
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('goblin_thief')
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('goblin_thief', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.goblin_thief)
	stage.QuestTracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString('goblin_thief_tracker_1'))
end

function local_class:mark_kid_girl()
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('goblin_thief')
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('goblin_thief', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.kid_girl)
	stage.QuestTracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString('goblin_thief_tracker_0'))
end

function local_class:throw_bag()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_bag_routine, self))
end

function local_class:throw_bag_routine()
	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ItemData')
	local item_place_holder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
	local goblin_bag_spec = item_data:GetSpec('goblin_thief_bag')
	item_place_holder.ItemId = goblin_bag_spec.Id
	item_place_holder.NotForInventory = true
	local drop_bag = CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(self.kid_girl.Position, self.goblin_thief.Position,
			item_place_holder, true, false, CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.DontFindLooter)

	local kid_girl = self.kid_girl
	kid_girl.SpineController:DeviateLocal(CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.1, 0.1)
	kid_girl.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
	kid_girl.SpineController:DamageSquish(1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	kid_girl:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('embarrassed', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.8))

	drop_bag.ConsumeTarget = self.goblin_thief
	drop_bag.State = CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.DontFindLooter
	drop_bag:Fly()
end

function local_class:quest_end()
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.RemoveIcon(self.kid_girl)

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('goblin_thief')
	stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	character_util.align_party(self.kid_girl, "right")

	self.scene:quest_end()

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.ClearQuest(nil, self.quest_progress, 0))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.on_event_received = nil
	self.kid_girl = nil
	self.goblin_thief = nil
end

function local_class:on_get_bag()
	local kid_girl = self.kid_girl

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.ProgressQuest(nil, self.quest_progress, 1))

	kid_girl:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('victory_extra', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))
	kid_girl.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestCleared(kid_girl)

	self:mark_kid_girl()
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('HalloweenBasketCatchController')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller@
		QuestName = HalloweenBasketCatch @
		Comment = 할로윈 이벤트 바구니로 사탕 받기 게임  @
]]

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, scene)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	self.game_clear_count = 7

	self.star_piece_name = 'basket_catch_star_piece'
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

function local_class:on_init()
	-- 기본 이벤트 섹션들 로드를 여기서 처리
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'HalloweenBasketCatchSection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'HalloweenBasketCatchSection2')
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	-- 퀘스트는 클리어했는데 스타피스 못먹었으면 스타피스 활성화
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece(self.star_piece_name) then
			local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
			star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		local eva = get_character('eva')
		character_util.add_listener(eva, self)
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1 then
		local door = get_field_object('house_1_in')
		self.cached_interactable = door.Interactable
		door.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local eva = get_character('eva')
	local interactable = self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1
	if interactable and not is_unity_null(eva) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, eva) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_eva, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('house_1_in')) and
			self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1 then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eva_appear, self)
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:eva_appear()
	local door = get_field_object('house_1_in')
	local eva = get_character('eva')
	local princess = user_party[1]

	party_util.align_to_target(door.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5, 'down')

	-- 노크 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_doorknock_01'})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dualgun_attack_right' })
	wait_for_sec(0.67)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_stage_in_teleport_01'})
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	eva.Position = field:GetMarker('eva_reset').position
	eva.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	eva:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	eva:RemoveAnimation()

	party_util.position_party(eva.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 자, 공주님! 여기 사탕입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_5', skip = true })

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})

	eva.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	eva:SetAnimation('eat', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(eva)
	character_util.look_at(eva, princess)

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = eva.Position, target = princess.Position, itemid = 20086,
								 lootstate = 'FixLooter', skip_text = true})
	item.ConsumeTarget = princess
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	door.Interactable = self.cached_interactable

	-- 캔디를 먹은 이벤트를 날려주기
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'get_candy', 'basket_catch_game' }))
end

--- 에바에게 상호작용하면 게임 시작
function local_class:interact_to_eva()
	local eva = get_character('eva')
	local princess = user_party[1]

	party_util.align_to_target(eva, 'right')

	if self.re_challenge then
		-- 공주님, 다시 시도해보시겠습니까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_46', skip = true })

		-- 다시 해보고 싶다고 하신다 / 다시 하고 싶지 않다고 하신다
		local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'halloween_basket_catch_new_47', 'mercy' }, { 'halloween_basket_catch_new_48', 'brutal' }}, 'release')

		-- 안한다고 하면 여기서 리턴
		if choose == 2 then
			return
		end

		-- 공주님 뜻이 그러시다면…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_49', skip = true})

		-- 사탕 {0}개를 받으시면 됩니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' })
		eva:SetEmotion('attack', true)
		eva:SetAnimation('release', true)
		character_util.add_animation_sfx(eva, '01_swing_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = game_string:Format('halloween_basket_catch_new_50', self.game_clear_count), skip = true })
		eva:RemoveEmotion()
		eva:RemoveAnimation()
	else
		-- 그래, 참가할 생각인가?
		character_util.look_at(eva, user_party.Leader)
		eva:RemoveEmotion()
		eva:RemoveAnimation()
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_18', skip = true})

		-- 나, 내가 해볼래!
		princess:SetEmotion('smile', true)
		character_util.normal_double_jump(princess, true)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_19', skip = true})
		princess:RemoveEmotion()

		-- 고, 공주님께서 말씀이십니까?
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02'})
		eva:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
		character_util.normal_jump(eva, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_20', skip = true})

		-- 참가한다 / 돌아간다.
		local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({{'halloween_basket_catch_new_21', 'mercy'}, {'halloween_basket_catch_new_22', 'brutal'}})

		-- 안한다고 하면 여기서 리턴
		if choose == 2 then
			eva:RemoveEmotion()
			return
		end

		-- 응!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_23', skip = true})

		-- … 알겠습니다.
		eva:RemoveEmotion()
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_24', skip = true})

		-- 신참, 너는 이따가 따로 보도록 하지.
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_03' })
		eva:SetEmotion('eyelight', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_25', skip = true})
		eva:RemoveEmotion()

		-- 규칙은 하나.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_26', skip = true})

		-- 모든 사탕을 떨어트리지 않고 받는 겁니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_27', skip = true})

		-- 그럼, 시작하겠습니다!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_28', skip = true})

		self.re_challenge = true
	end

	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	local starpiece_appeared = self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete and
								not stage_progress:HasStarPiece(self.star_piece_name)

	local result
	local game_over = false

	if self.custom_event_handler ~= nil then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.custom_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	end

	local play_character_name = user_party.Count >= 2 and user_party[1].Name or ''
	local character = get_character(play_character_name)

	self.custom_event_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'basket_catch_game_loaded' then
				eva.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

				-- 스타피스가 이미 노출되어있다면 게임이 진행될동안 숨겨줌.
				if starpiece_appeared then
					star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				end
			elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'basket_catch_dispose' then
				eva.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				eva.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')

				princess.Position = eva.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5
				character_util.look_at(princess, eva)

				user_party.Leader.Position = princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.right
				character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, eva)

				-- 스타피스가 노출됐었다면 다시 활성화 시켜줌
				if starpiece_appeared then
					star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				end

				if play_character_name == 'pumpkin_kid' then
					character:RemoveUpperAnimation(character.UnityGameObject)
				end
			elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'basket_catch_game' and e:GetParamAt(1) == 'end' then
				game_over = true
				result = e:GetParamAt(2)
			end
		end
	}
	message_system:Subscribe(self.custom_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'callback')

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(eva, { 'basket_catch_game', 'start', play_character_name , tostring(self.game_clear_count) }))

	if play_character_name == 'pumpkin_kid' then
		character:SetUpperAnimation(character.UnityGameObject, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('[skin]pumpkin', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.MarioJump, true))
	end

	-- 게임이 끝날때까지 대기
	while not game_over do coroutine.yield() end

	if result == 'perfect_clear' then
		self:perfect_success_reaction()
	elseif result == 'normal_clear' then
		self:normal_success_reaction()
	else
		self:fail_reaction()
	end
end

function local_class:perfect_success_reaction()
	local eva = get_character('eva')
	local princess = user_party[1]

	-- 그야말로 완벽…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_01' })
	eva:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	eva:SetAnimation('clap', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_29', skip = true})
	eva:RemoveAnimation()

	-- 잘하셨습니다, 공주님!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_30', skip = true})

	-- 고마워, 에바!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_31', skip = true})

	-- 카밀라 여왕님께서 이 모습을 볼 수 있으셨다면…
	eva:SetEmotion('tired', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_32', skip = true})

	character_util.remove_emotion(eva)

	-- 여기 약속했던 상품입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_33', skip = true})

	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		eva:RemoveEmotion()
		eva:SetAnimation('eat', true)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		eva:RemoveAnimation()

		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = eva.Position, target = princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, itemid = 20207,
												  lootstate = 'FixLooter'})
		item.ConsumeTarget = princess
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		-- 어, 이거 신선님 나리가 좋아하는 거다!
		princess:SetEmotion('smile', true)
		character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_36', skip = true })

		-- 헤헤, 이따 신선님한테 줘야지.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_37', skip = true })

		princess:RemoveEmotion()
	else
		--스타피스 던져줌.
		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
		message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(eva.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), false))
		wait_for_sec(2)

		-- 이거 {Player Name}가 좋아하는 건데!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01' })
		princess:SetEmotion('smile', true)
		character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = game_string:Format("halloween_basket_catch_new_34", user.Name), skip = true})

		-- 헤헤, 이건 {Player Name} 줄게. 선물이야!
		character_util.look_at(princess, user_party.Leader)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = game_string:Format("halloween_basket_catch_new_35", user.Name), skip = true})

		princess:RemoveEmotion()

		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:normal_success_reaction()
	local eva = get_character('eva')
	local princess = user_party[1]

	-- 음! 잘하셨습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01'})
	eva:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_38', skip = true})

	-- 여기 상품인 사탕입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_39', skip = true})

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})

	eva:RemoveEmotion()
	eva:SetAnimation('eat', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	eva:RemoveAnimation()

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = eva.Position, target = princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, itemid = 20086,
											  lootstate = 'FixLooter', skip_text = true})
	item.ConsumeTarget = princess
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 실수 없이 성공하면 더 특별한 상품이 있습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_40', skip = true})

	-- 관심 있으시면 다시 도전해 보시죠.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_41', skip = true})
end

function local_class:fail_reaction()
	local eva = get_character('eva')

	-- 아아… 간발의 차!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_01' })
	eva:SetEmotion('tired', true)
	character_util.normal_jump(eva, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_42', skip = true })

	-- 안타깝군요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_43', skip = true })

	-- 공주님이라면 몇 번이라도 다시 도전 가능합니다.
	eva:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_44', skip = true })

	-- 언제든 다시 들려주십시오.
	eva:SetAnimation('release', true)
	character_util.add_animation_sfx(eva, '01_swing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'halloween_basket_catch_new_45', skip = true })

	eva:RemoveEmotion()
	eva:RemoveAnimation()
end

	return false
end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.custom_event_handler ~= nil then

	self.scene = nil

		end
	end

	self.get_marvin = function() return get_character('red_green_tagger') end
	self.get_mover = function(num) return get_character('red_green_mover_' .. num) end
	self.get_plitvice = function() return get_character('red_green_mover_1') end
	self.get_lavi = function() return get_character('red_green_mover_2') end

	self.get_door = function() return get_field_object('house_3_in') end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_resource()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_event')

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'HalloweenRedGreenSection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'HalloweenRedGreenSection2'),
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		character_util.add_listener(self.get_marvin(), self)

		-- 퀘스트는 클리어했는데 스타피스 못먹었으면 스타피스 활성화
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece(self.star_piece_name) then
				local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
				star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_marvin()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_trio, self))
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_door()) and self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_knock, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'red_green' and e.Params[1] == 'end' then
			self:move_basket_position(vector(53.5, 0, 33.5))
			if e.Params[2] == 'win' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_win, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Params[2] == 'lose' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_lose, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			-- 사탕 담아놓은 바구니
			self.caught_items = {}
			self.player_basket = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = vector(53.5, 0, 33.5),
					  itemid = 20179, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

			for i = 1, 5 do
				local item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = vector(58, 0, 36), itemid = 20086,
														 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true})
				item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
				item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
				item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
				item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
				item:SetSortingLayer(true)
				table.insert(self.caught_items, item)
			end

			self:move_basket_position(vector(53.5, 0, 33.5))
		end))
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1 then
		local door = self.get_door()
		self.cached_interactable = door.Interactable
		door.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:try_knock()
	local marvin = self.get_marvin()
	local lavi = self.get_lavi()
	local plitvice = self.get_plitvice()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local knight = self.get_knight()

	local door = self.get_door()
	local door_front_pos = door.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)

	--문에 인터렉트 시

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	-- 바구니 제거
	if self.player_basket ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.player_basket)
		self.player_basket = nil
	end

	-- 바구니 안의 쌓여진 아이템들 제거
	for _,item in ipairs(self.caught_items) do
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
	end

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil

function local_class:move_basket_position(pos)
	self.player_basket.Position = pos

	local x_offsets = { -0.16, 0.02, 0.19 }
	local z_offsets = { 0.04, 0.05, 0.09 }
	local row_offset = 0.1

	for i, item in ipairs(self.caught_items) do
		local row = math.floor((i - 1) / 3) + 1
		local col = math.floor((i - 1) % 3) + 1
		item.Position = self.player_basket.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * x_offsets[col] +
				unity_class.vector3.forward * (row_offset * (row - 1) + z_offsets[col] -0.05 ) + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.1
		item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite)):SetSortingOrder(row + 1)
	end
end


return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then

		end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_vishuvac()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_gambler, self))
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_door()) and self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_knock, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'shell_game' and e.Params[1] == 'end' then
			if e.Params[2] == 'win' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_game, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Params[2] == 'lose' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_game, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

		local door = get_field_object('house_2_in')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 1, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 1, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(girgas, 1, 0)

	knight.Position = vector(8, 0, 32)
	princess.Position = vector(9, 0, 32)
	knight.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	princess.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up

	girgas.Position = vector(9, 0, 34)
	vishuvac.Position = vector(8, 0, 34)
	girgas.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	vishuvac.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	camera_util.move_async(vector(8.5, 0, 33), 0)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 사탕 받으러 왔다고 했지? 여기!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vishuvac, {key = 'halloween_shell_game_13', skip = true})

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	vishuvac.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	vishuvac:SetAnimation('eat', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(girgas)
	eat_sfx:Stop()

	character_util.look_at(vishuvac, princess)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = vishuvac.Position, target = princess.Position, itemid = 20086,
								 lootstate = 'FixLooter', skip_text = true})
	item.ConsumeTarget = princess

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader()

	door.Interactable = self.cached_door_interactable

	-- 캔디를 먹은 이벤트를 날려주기
