function local_class:talk_with_gambler()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local vishuvac = self.get_vishuvac()

	if vishuvac.Direction == character_util.get_direction('right') then
		party_util.align_to_target(vishuvac, 'right', 1, 'linear')
	else
		party_util.align_to_target(vishuvac, 'down', 1, 'linear')
	end

	--자, 어느 강아지가 사탕을 가져갔을까?
	character_util.look_at(vishuvac, user_party.Leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vishuvac, { key = 'halloween_shell_game_18', skip = true })

	-- 맞추시는 사람한테 내가 좋은걸 주고 있으니까, 꼭 참여해 보라고. / 상품은 없지만, 놀이는 몇 번이든 해도 좋아!
	local key = (self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete) and
			'halloween_shell_game_19_1' or 'halloween_shell_game_19'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vishuvac, { key = key, skip = true })

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'halloween_shell_game_branch_1_1', 'mercy'},
		{'halloween_shell_game_branch_1_2', 'brutal'}
	})

	if result == 1 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'shell_game', 'start' }))
	else
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:win_game()
	local vishuvac = self.get_vishuvac()

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--비슈바크: 성공이야! 제법인데?
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_clap_01')
	party_util.set_direction('left')
	character_util.set_emotion(vishuvac, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(vishuvac, {name = 'clap'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vishuvac, { key = 'halloween_shell_game_25', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(vishuvac)

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		--비슈바크: 여기, 약속했던 선물!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vishuvac, { key = 'halloween_shell_game_26', skip = true })

		--스타피스 던져준다.
		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
		message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(vishuvac.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0)))
		wait_for_sec(2)

		--비슈바크: 즐거운 할로윈 보내!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(vishuvac, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(vishuvac, { name = 'cast2' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vishuvac, { key = 'halloween_shell_game_27', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(vishuvac)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self, 0)
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:lose_game()
	local vishuvac = self.get_vishuvac()

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--비슈바크: 아쉽게 됐네.
	party_util.set_direction('left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vishuvac, { key = 'halloween_shell_game_23', skip = true })

	--비슈바크: 실패해도 또 도전할 수 있으니까, 언제든 다시 해 봐!
	character_util.set_anim(vishuvac, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vishuvac, { key = 'halloween_shell_game_24', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(vishuvac)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

	female.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	-- 여성 없이 들어가지 못하게 집 앞의 문을 닫음
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_name))

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then

	else
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(female)
	end

-- 캔터베리 여성과 상호작용
function local_class:interact_female(activate_quest)
	local female = self.get_female()

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(female)

	party_util.align_to_target(female, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	-- "…길을 잃었어요…"
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female, { key = 'haunted_house_1', skip = true })

	-- "집까지… 데려다주실래요?"
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female, { key = 'haunted_house_2', skip = true })

	local is_accepted = false

	if activate_quest ~= nil and activate_quest then
		is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)
	else
		-- 거절 / 수락
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'haunted_house_2_1', 'brutal' }, { 'haunted_house_2_2', 'mercy' } })

		is_accepted = choose_result == 2
	end

	if is_accepted then
		-- 수락한 경우
		-- "그럼… 부탁드릴게요…"
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female, { key = 'haunted_house_4', skip = true })

		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)

		-- 켄터베리 여성이 플레이어를 따라다니게 설정
		-- 개가 이미 붙어 있는 경우, 개 뒤에 따라다니게 한다.
		local doggy = self.get_doggy()
		local follwer_index = 0

		if lua_helper.type_compare(doggy.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState) then
			follwer_index = 1
		end

		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(female, user_party, follwer_index, 0)
		female:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
		female.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		female.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

		-- 들어가지 못하게 해놨던 집 앞의 문을 열어놓음
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_name))

		if activate_quest ~= nil and activate_quest then
			yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self)
		end
	else
		-- 거절한 경우
		if activate_quest ~= nil and activate_quest then
			screen_util.quest_decline_Event()
		end

		-- "…그렇군요."
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female, { key = 'haunted_house_3', skip = true })

		if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
			quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(female)
		else
			quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(female)
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')

	while not CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.IsLoaded(pool) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.MessyText.PreLoad()

	while not CS.MessyText.IsLoaded() do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if stage.Name == self.high_school3_stage_name and self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 12 then
		--타이머 로드
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.EventTimer)
	elseif stage.Name == self.high_school5_stage_name then
		local is_admiral_section = self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 17
		if is_admiral_section then
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('stage_item')
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_shockwave')
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.high_school6_stage_name then
		local is_admiral_section = self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 18 and self.quest_progress.Grade < 0
		if is_admiral_section then
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('stage_item')
			CS.Oak.BasicSwordHitEffect:Preload()
		end
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event()
	local is_kendo_section = self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 7 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 9
	local is_science_dept_section = self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 10 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 12
	local is_cafeteria_section = self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 13 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 15
	local is_admiral_section = self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 16 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 17

	if stage.Name == self.high_school2_stage_name and is_kendo_section then
		local screenplay_kendo_leader = get_character('kendo_leader')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_opening, self,
						screenplay_kendo_leader, vector(-300, 0, -300), 'highschool_1_2_boss_name', 'doyagao', 'katana_idle'))
	elseif stage.Name == self.high_school3_stage_name and is_science_dept_section then
		local screenplay_marian = get_character('rockman_marian')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_opening, self,
				screenplay_marian, vector(-300, 0, -300), 'highschool_iron_teatan_title', 'doyagao', 'idle'))
	elseif stage.Name == self.high_school4_stage_name and is_cafeteria_section then
		local screenplay_sohee = get_character('highschool_sohee_boss')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_opening, self,
				screenplay_sohee, vector(-300, 0, -300), 'highschool_sohee_boss_title', 'doyagao', 'cast2'))
	elseif stage.Name == self.high_school5_stage_name and is_admiral_section then
		local screenplay_admiral = get_character('boss_admiral')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_opening, self,
				screenplay_admiral, vector(-300, 0, -300), 'highschool_1_5_boss_name', 'idle', 'idle'))

function local_class:add_battle_rolling_number()

	CS.Oak.RollingNumberManager.Instance:RollingNumber(rolling_param)

function local_class:create_rolling_number_param(transform, target_number, type, duration, play_sfx)
	local param = CS.Oak.RollingNumberParam()
	param.Target = transform
	param.Number = target_number
	param.RollingNumberEaseType = type
	param.RollingTime = duration
	param.PlaySfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_sfx, true)
	param.Color = unity_class.color(1, 1, 1, 1)
	return param
end

function local_class:set_rolling_number_data(target, target_number, type, duration)
	local param = CS.Oak.RollingNumberParam()
	param.Target = target
	param.Number = target_number
	param.RollingNumberEaseType = type
	param.RollingTime = duration
	param.Color = unity_class.color(1, 1, 1, 1)

	CS.Oak.RollingNumberManager.Instance:ShowRollingNumber(param)

	if self.rolling_number_data:ContainsKey(param.Target) then
		self.rolling_number_data[param.Target] = param.Number
		return
	end

	self.rolling_number_data:Add(param.Target, param.Number)
end

function local_class:remove_rolling_number_data(target)
	CS.Oak.RollingNumberManager.Instance:ReturnRollingNumber(target)
	if self.rolling_number_data:ContainsKey(target) then
		self.rolling_number_data:Remove(target)
	end
end

function local_class:section11_to_13_setting()
	if stage.Name == self.high_school3_stage_name and self.quest_progress ~= nil then

		-- 이미 과학부 이벤트를 다 봤거나 아직 보지못하는 상태라면 관련 FO 전부 비활성화
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 13 or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 10 then
			local disable_objs = {
				get_character('marian'),
				get_character('iron_teatan'),
				get_character('insider_1'),
				get_character('insider_2'),
				get_character('insider_3'),
				get_character('insider_to_nerd_1'),
				get_character('insider_to_nerd_2'),
				get_character('insider_to_nerd_3'),
				get_field_object('invader_crystal')
			}

			-- 아이언티탄 잡몹들도 전부 테이블에 할당
			for i = 1, 6 do
				for j = 1, 6 do
					local wave_str = 'wave' .. i
					local number_str = '_' .. j
					disable_objs[#disable_objs + 1] = get_character('boss_' .. wave_str .. number_str)
				end
			end

			for _, fo in ipairs(disable_objs) do
				fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		end

		-- 문을 한번 열었었다면 스테이지 입장할때마다 계속 열려있도록 처리
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 12 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_school_3'))
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 11 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 12 then
			local marian = get_character('marian')
			local iron_teatan = get_character('iron_teatan')

			iron_teatan.Transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)

			local pilot_spot = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(iron_teatan.Transform, 'teatan_hero_spot')
			local offset = unity_class.vector3.down * 0.2
			marian.Position = pilot_spot.position + offset
			marian.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
			marian.Transform.parent = pilot_spot
			marian.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

			local disable_npcs = {
				get_character('insider_1'),
				get_character('insider_2'),
				get_character('insider_3'),
				get_character('insider_to_nerd_1'),
				get_character('insider_to_nerd_2'),
				get_character('insider_to_nerd_3'),
			}
			for _, npc in ipairs(disable_npcs) do
				npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end

			local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.science_dept_marker_name, quest_id, is_story, iron_teatan)
		end
	end
end

	boss.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

	stage_camera:Move(pivot, 0)
	stage_camera:ResizeTo(2, 0)

	local pooled_object = {}
	---[[ 배경
	pooled_object[1] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(
			unity_class.vector3.one)
	local bg_sprite = pooled_object[1].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	---]]

	---[[ 띠

			unity_class.vector3.one)
	local ribbon_sprite = pooled_object[2].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	---]]

	---[[ 깃발
	pooled_object[3] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(
			unity_class.vector3.one)
	local flag_sprite = pooled_object[3].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	---]]

	---[[ 사자 장식 1
	pooled_object[4] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(
			unity_class.vector3.one)
	local lion_sprite_a = pooled_object[4].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	---]]

	---[[ 사자 장식 2
	pooled_object[5] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(
			unity_class.vector3.one)
	local lion_sprite_b = pooled_object[5].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	---]]

	self.sprites_data = {
		{
			sprite = bg_sprite,
			sprite_name = 'stage_in_back_tile.png',
			local_scale = vector(10, 3),
			start_pos = pivot,
			end_pos = pivot

			sprite_name = 'stage_in_line.png',

			start_pos = pivot + vector(0, 0, 5),
			end_pos = pivot + vector(0, 0, -0.3)

		{
			sprite = flag_sprite,
			sprite_name = 'stage_in_flag.png',
			local_scale = vector(2, 1.7),
			start_pos = pivot + vector(0, 0, 5),
			end_pos = pivot + vector(0, 0, -0.3)

			sprite_name = 'stage_in_deco_b.png',
			local_scale = vector(2, 1.5),
			start_pos = pivot + vector(0, 0, -5),

		},
		{
			sprite = lion_sprite_a,
			sprite_name = 'stage_in_deco_a.png',
			local_scale = vector(2, 1.5),
			start_pos = pivot + vector(0, 0, -5),
			end_pos = pivot + vector(0, 0, 0.3)
		}
	}

	for i = 1, #self.sprites_data do
		self.sprites_data[i].sprite.Transform.localPosition = self.sprites_data[i].start_pos
		self.sprites_data[i].sprite.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
		self.sprites_data[i].sprite.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		self.sprites_data[i].sprite.LocalScale = self.sprites_data[i].local_scale
		self.sprites_data[i].sprite:SetSortingOrder(background_order + i)
	end

	stage.StageCustomAtlasManager:Load('ondemand/highschool/ui', 'LiveEvent_highschool_custom', function (atlas)
		for i = 1, #self.sprites_data do
			self.sprites_data[i].sprite.Atlas = atlas
			self.sprites_data[i].sprite.SpriteName = self.sprites_data[i].sprite_name
			self.sprites_data[i].sprite:Rebuild()
		end
	end)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	local bgm_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(CS.Foundations.GameEnvironment.IsKongJapan,

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.8

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		--배경 제외
		for i = 2, #self.sprites_data do
			local start_z = self.sprites_data[i].start_pos.z
			local end_z = self.sprites_data[i].end_pos.z

			local cur_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_z, end_z, progress)

			self.sprites_data[i].sprite.Transform.localPosition = vector(self.sprites_data[i].sprite.Transform.localPosition.x, 0, cur_z)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	time_passed = 0
	duration = 0.2

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuart(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		boss.SpineController:AddColor(boss.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(progress, progress, progress, 1), 1, 0)

		--배경 제외
		for i = 2, #self.sprites_data do
			local start_z = self.sprites_data[i].end_pos.z
			local end_z = pivot.z

			local cur_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_z, end_z, progress)

			self.sprites_data[i].sprite.Transform.localPosition = vector(self.sprites_data[i].sprite.Transform.localPosition.x, 0, cur_z)
		end

		self.sprites_data[#self.sprites_data].sprite.TintColor = unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1 - progress})
		self.sprites_data[#self.sprites_data].sprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 2, #self.sprites_data do
		self.sprites_data[i].sprite.Transform.localPosition = pivot
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_gatcha_spotlight_01')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		CS.MessyText.SetMessyText(game_string:GetString(boss_name),
			vector(0, -0.8), 0, 800, 30, 0, nil, 0, 3.5))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(boss, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(boss, {name = emotion_name})
	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = anim_name})

	wait_for_sec(2)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	for i = 1, #pooled_object do
		pooled_object[i]:Dispose()
	end

	character_util.set_position(boss, boss_pre_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(boss, boss_pre_dir)
	character_util.remove_anim(boss)
	character_util.remove_emotion(boss)

	boss.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true
	boss.SpineController:ResetAllColors()

	stage_camera:Move(user_party_leader.Position, 0, user_party_leader)
	stage_camera:ResizeTo(CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize, 0)

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	local start_marker = field:GetMarker("default_start")

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(start_marker.position,
			start_marker.direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent), 'on_event')

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()

	end


	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:exclusive_on_setting(fade)
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then return end

	-- FIXED : [PS-9920] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1
	local request_id = self.current_request_id

	local engineer = self.get_engineer()
	local room_android_1 = self.get_room_android(1)
	local room_android_2 = self.get_room_android(2)

	local npcs = { engineer, room_android_1, room_android_2 }

	local android_head = get_field_object('android_engineer_android_head')

	-- FIXED : [PS-9327] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈 + 캐싱 여부 체크를 하지 않아 NullCrashBehaviour가 캐싱되는 이슈 조치
	if not self.repaired_android and self.android_head_crash_behaviour_type == nil then
		message_system:SendSync(android_head, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

		-- DamageGimmickCrashBehaviour라면 일부 값을 복구하기 위해 캐싱한다.
		if lua_helper.type_compare(android_head.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.DamageGimmickCrashBehaviour) then
			self.non_damage_time = android_head.CrashBehaviour.NonDamageTime
			self.use_knockback = android_head.CrashBehaviour.UseKnockBack
		end

		self.android_head_crash_behaviour_type = android_head.CrashBehaviour:GetType()
		android_head.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self.cs_controller)
	end

	engineer.Interactable.Talk = nil

	if not fade then
		for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 1)
		end

		if not self.repaired_android then
			self:spine_alpha_fade(android_head, 0, 1)
		end

		if self.android_body then
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.android_body, 0, 1)
		else
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end
	else
		for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)
		end

		if not self.repaired_android then
			self:spine_alpha_fade(android_head, 0, 0)
		end

		if self.android_body then
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.android_body, 0, 0)
		end
	end

	-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
	if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
		return
	end

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	end

	if not self.repaired_android then
		character_util.set_active_state(android_head, 'disabled')
	end
end

--- Exclusive Off 세팅
function local_class:exclusive_off_setting(fade)
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then return end

	-- FIXED : [PS-9855] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1
	local request_id = self.current_request_id

	local engineer = self.get_engineer()
	local room_android_1 = self.get_room_android(1)
	local room_android_2 = self.get_room_android(2)

	local npcs = { engineer, room_android_1, room_android_2 }

	local android_head = get_field_object('android_engineer_android_head')

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	end

	if not self.repaired_android then
		character_util.set_active_state(android_head, 'enabled')
	end

	if not fade then
		for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 1)
		end

		if not self.repaired_android then
			self:spine_alpha_fade(android_head, 1, 1)
		end

		if self.android_body then
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(self.android_body, 1)
		else
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end
	else
		for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 0)
		end

		if not self.repaired_android then
			self:spine_alpha_fade(android_head, 1, 0)
		end

		if self.android_body then
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(self.android_body, 0)
		end
	end

	-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
	if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
		return
	end

	if not self.repaired_android and self.android_head_crash_behaviour_type then
		-- 크래시 비헤비어를 복구해준다.
		-- 비헤비어 류는 타입을 캐싱했다 싱글톤 인스턴스 or new 인스턴스를 넣어줘야함
		local restored_crash_behaviour = character_util.create_component_with_type(self.android_head_crash_behaviour_type)

		-- DamageGimmickCrashBehaviour라면 일부 값을 복구한다.
		if lua_helper.type_compare(restored_crash_behaviour, CS.Oak.DamageGimmickCrashBehaviour) then
			restored_crash_behaviour.NonDamageTime = self.non_damage_time
			restored_crash_behaviour.UseKnockBack = self.use_knockback
		end
		android_head.CrashBehaviour = restored_crash_behaviour

		-- 복구했으니 타입 캐싱을 제거한다.
		self.android_head_crash_behaviour_type = nil
	end

	if self.repaired_android then
		if self.interact_android then
			character_util.add_listener(engineer, self.cs_controller)
		else
			character_util.add_listener(room_android_1, self.cs_controller)
			character_util.add_listener(room_android_2, self.cs_controller)
			engineer.Interactable.Talk = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_3'
		end
	end
end

function local_class:spine_alpha_fade(android_head, alpha, duration)
	android_head.UnityGameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController)):SetAlphaFade(alpha, duration)
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:fade_routine(event_start_with_fade_out, alpha, duration)
	local beth = self.get_beth()

	local fade_routine_internal = function(fo, alpha_to_target, fading_duration, activate)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, alpha_to_target, fading_duration)
		character_util.set_active_state(fo, activate)
	end

	local active = 'disabled'
	if alpha == 1 then
		active = 'enabled'
	end

	if event_start_with_fade_out then
		fade_routine_internal(beth, alpha, 0, active)
	else
		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(fade_routine_internal, beth, alpha, duration, active),
		})
	end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	for i = 1, #self.janitor_debuff_effects do
		if self.janitor_debuff_effects[i] ~= nil then
			self.janitor_debuff_effects[i]:Dispose()
		end
	end

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

-- 베스에게 프레데터를 돌려주는 선택지를 틀어주는 루틴
function local_class:play_choose_giving_predator_back_event()
	return choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 프레데터를 돌려준다.
		{ self.common_script_key .. 1, 'intellect' },
		-- 떠난다.
		{ self.common_script_key .. 2, 'mercy' }
	})
end

function local_class:play_beth_fall_down()
	stage_camera:CancelMove()

	local beth = self.get_beth()

	-- (화장실 밖으로 나가려 하면 갑자기 하늘에서 베스 내려찍기로 등장. 주인공 화장실 쪽으로 튕겨나가서 헤롱헤롱)
	local time_passed = 0
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 0.25
	local jump_height = 7

	local jump_start_pos = vector(-41.5, jump_height, user_party.Leader.Position.z - 0.5)
	local target_pos = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, user_party.Leader.Position.z - 0.75)

	character_util.remove_anim(beth)
	character_util.set_emotion(beth, { name = 'drunken' })
	local fall_sfx = 	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = "01_fall_down_01"})
	character_util.set_position(beth, jump_start_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(beth, 'left')

	--region 자유낙하
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, jump_height - 0.8, 0)

	character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'invader_knight/attack2', loop = false, scale = 1.7 })
	while(unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(beth, jump_start_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * dist_y, true)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
	--endregion

	fall_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.set_position(beth, vector(beth.Position.x, 0, beth.Position.z))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_big_01')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_buttbounce_preset):Instantiate(beth.Position)
	stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged', loop = true })

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local friction_time = 0.7
	local player_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	local friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 2500, 0.3)
	local friction_clone = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 2500, 0.3)
	friction_clone:Proceed(friction_time)

	--local player_fin_pos = player_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * friction_clone:GetDistance()

	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)

	free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(4, 11.2, 0, 0)

	user_party.Leader.SpineController:Rotate(720, 0.7)

	if (user_party.Leader.CharacterInfo ~= nil) then
		music_player:PlayVoice(user_party.Leader.CharacterInfo, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Damaged1)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_hit_wall_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_01')

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < friction_time) do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()
		local dist_z = friction:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader,
				player_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * dist_y + unity_class.vector3.forward * dist_z, true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, user_party.Leader.Position.z))
	user_party.Leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('confused', true)

	local re_members = user_party.Count - 1
	if (re_members == 1) then
		local ref_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers)
	elseif (re_members == 2) then
		local angle_range = 45
		local dist = CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers

		local ref_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-angle_range, unity_class.vector3.up) *
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * dist)

		ref_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle_range, unity_class.vector3.up) *
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * dist)
	elseif (re_members == 3) then
		local angle_range = 60
		local dist = CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * 1.25
		local ref_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-angle_range, unity_class.vector3.up) *
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * dist)

		ref_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * dist)

		ref_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle_range, unity_class.vector3.up) *
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * dist)
	end

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		waypoint_list:Add(vec_list[i - 1])

		character_util.move_waypoint(user_party[i], waypoint_list, 6, false, 'stop', 'floor', cur_dir)
	end

	local waited = 0

	while (waited ~= user_party.Count - 1) do
		waited = 0

		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
			if (user_party[i].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped) then
				user_party[i]:SetAnimation('idle', true)

				waited = waited + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 베스 : ....아무리 생각해도 네놈한테 빚을 진 상태는 견딜 수 없어.
	character_util.remove_anim(beth)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(beth, 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, { key = self.common_script_key .. 18, skip = true })

	-- (스타피스 2 개 등장)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	local star_piece_1 = get_field_object('beth_star_piece_1')
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece_1, beth.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.25),
			user_party.Leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))

	local star_piece_2 = get_field_object('beth_star_piece_2')
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece_2, beth.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.25),
			user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))

	wait_for_sec(2.75)

	-- 베스 : 이걸로 프레데터의 빚은 갚았다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, { key = self.common_script_key .. 19, skip = true })

	-- 베스 : ...괜히 생색낼 생각은 하지 않는게 좋아.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, { key = self.common_script_key .. 20, skip = true })

	-- (베스 뒤돌아서 술 한잔 꺼내서 들이킨 후 (beth_drink 모션) 달려서 떠남)
	character_util.set_direction(beth, 'left')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drinking_01')
	character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'unique/drunk_seat' })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'invader_knight/run', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')
	character_util.move_distance_async(beth, vector(0, 0, -6),
			nil, 5, true, false, true)
	character_util.set_position(beth, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_active_state(beth, 'disabled')

	-- (퀘스트 종료 연출 - 주인공 마리오 점프하며 일어남).

	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- (퀘스트 종료 + 세이프 하우스 멤버 추가는 실제로 여기까지 본 상태에서 되도록. 베스 나레이션 박스 뜨는 시점이 아님.)
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self, 0, true, false, false, false)
end

-- 스테이지 시작 시, 화장실 앞에 테러리스트 시체들 배치해주는 루틴.
function local_class:initialize_terrorist_corpses()
	local corpse_key = 'beth_terrorist_corpse_'
	local corpse_init_pos_key = 'beth_terrorist_corpse_init_pos_'

	local initialize_terrorist_corpse = function(corpse)
		character_util.set_active_state(corpse, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_anim(corpse, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false})
		character_util.set_emotion(corpse, { name = 'damaged'})
		corpse.SpineController:AddColor(corpse.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(0, 0, 0, 1), 0.55, 0)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(corpse, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	for i = 1, 10 do
		local corpse = get_character(corpse_key .. i)
		initialize_terrorist_corpse(corpse)

		local dir = lua_helper.get_conditional_value((i % 2) == 0, 'left', 'right')
		character_util.set_position(corpse, field:GetMarker(corpse_init_pos_key .. i).position)
		character_util.set_direction(corpse, dir)
	end

	local destroyable_corpse_key = 'beth_terrorist_corpse_destroyable_'

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local corpse = get_character(destroyable_corpse_key .. i)
		initialize_terrorist_corpse(corpse)
	end
end

function local_class:beth_jump(target_pos)
	local beth = self.get_beth()
	local finished_jump = false
	local jump_duration = 0.3
	local jump_height = 15
	local time_passed = 0

	self.jump_start_position = beth.Position

	stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.4, 0.1)

	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_invaderknight_stomp')
	pool:Instantiate(self.jump_start_position)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_beth_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})

	while finished_jump == false do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / jump_duration
		beth.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position,
			self:get_height_at(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * jump_height * progress

		if time_passed > jump_duration then
			finished_jump = true
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
	beth.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, self:get_height_at(target_pos))
end

function local_class:play_beth_stomp_attack(target_pos)
	local beth = self.get_beth()
	character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'invader_knight/attack2', loop = false, scale = 3 })
	character_util.set_emotion(beth, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_direction(beth, 'down')

	local time_passed = 0
	local fall_duration = 0.25
	local jump_height = 15
	local is_start_stomp_effect = false
	local did_stomped = false

	while(did_stomped == false) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= fall_duration - 0.3 and not is_start_stomp_effect then
			self:create_cross_explosion_fx(target_pos)
			camera_util.resize_to(3.3, 0.2)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_ficklelady_explosion_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')
			is_start_stomp_effect = true
		elseif time_passed >= fall_duration - 0.1 then
			stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.6, 0.7)
		end

		if time_passed >= fall_duration then
			did_stomped = true
			time_passed = 0
		elseif time_passed < fall_duration and did_stomped == false then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(time_passed, 0, 1, fall_duration))
			beth.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, self:get_height_at(self.jump_start_position))
					+ unity_class.vector3.up * jump_height * (1 - progress)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:create_cross_explosion_fx(target_pos)
	local effect_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, self:get_height_at(target_pos) + 0.1)
	local cross_fx_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_darkmagician_cross_explosion')
	return cross_fx_pool:Instantiate(effect_pos)
end

function local_class:get_height_at(target_pos)
	return field:GetTileInfoAt(target_pos):GetHeightAt(target_pos)
end

function local_class:play_item_get_event(fo)
	local item_target_pos = vector(fo.Position.x, 1.45, fo.Position.z)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_get_keyitem_01")
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'get', loop = true})

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = self.predator_item_id, pos = item_target_pos,
			  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.6,
			  showoncharacter = true, skip_text = true })
	item:SetSortingLayer(true)

	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.5)
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.1)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < 1.5 do
		local delta = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / 1.5
		local curpos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(fo.Position, item_target_pos, delta)

		item:SetPosition(curpos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	character_util.remove_anim(fo)
	character_util.remove_emotion(fo)

	item:ConsumeComplete()

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:interact_priest(is_align)

	local priest_2 = self.get_priest(2)
	local believer_1 = self.get_believer(1)
	local believer_2 = self.get_believer(2)
	local believer_3 = self.get_believer(3)
	local believer_4 = self.get_believer(4)

	is_align = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_align, true)
	if is_align then
		party_util.align_to_target(priest_1, 'up', 1, 'arc')
	end

	-- 용사교 사제1: 자, 용사님. 저희에게 바라시는 것이 있을까요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_53', skip = true })

	-- 선택지 : 세이프하우스로 대피 지시 / 이곳에서 대기 지시.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_53_1', 'mercy' }, { 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_53_2', 'intellect' } })
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 선택지: 세이프하우스로 대피 지시
		-- 용사교 사제1: 알겠습니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_54', skip = true })

		-- 용사교 사제1(shout): 모두 모이세요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(priest_1, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_55', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

		-- 사제 앞으로 모두 모인다.
		-- 신틸라 제외
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(party_util.align_to_target, priest_1, 'left', 1, 'linear'),
			util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, priest_2, priest_1.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 7, true, nil, nil, 'up', true),
			util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, believer_1, { vector(16, 0, 108), vector(16, 0, 106) }, 7, true, nil, nil, 'down', true),
			util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, believer_2, { vector(17, 0, 108), vector(17, 0, 106) }, 7, true, nil, nil, 'down', true),
			util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, believer_3, { vector(18, 0, 108), vector(18, 0, 106) }, 7, true, nil, nil, 'down', true),
			util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, believer_4, { vector(19, 0, 108), vector(19, 0, 106) }, 7, true, nil, nil, 'down', true)
		})
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 용사교 사제1: 지금부터 용사님이 말씀하신 세이프하우스로 이동합니다!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_56', skip = true })

		character_util.set_emotion(priest_2, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_emotion(believer_3, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_emotion(believer_4, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(believer_3, { name = 'clap' })
		character_util.set_anim(believer_4, { name = 'clap' })

		-- 남자1: 세이프하우스라니, 역시 용사님이야!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')
		character_util.set_emotion(believer_1, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(believer_1, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(believer_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_57', skip = true })

		-- 여자1: 예언대로였어.
		character_util.set_emotion(believer_2, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(believer_2, { name = 'sing' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(believer_2, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_58', skip = true })

		-- 용사교 사제1: 용사님 행운을 빌겠습니다.
		character_util.look_at(priest_1, user_party.Leader)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_59', skip = true })

		-- 용사교 사제2: 용사님, 만세!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_direction(priest_2, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(priest_2, { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_2, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_60', skip = true })

		character_util.set_emotion(believer_1, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_anim(believer_2)
		character_util.remove_anim(believer_3)
		character_util.remove_anim(believer_4)
		character_util.remove_anim(priest_2)

		-- 모두 퇴장
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_buzz_02')
		character_util.move_waypoint(priest_1, { priest_1.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), priest_1.Position + vector(5, 0, -12) }, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')
		character_util.move_waypoint(priest_2, { priest_2.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), priest_2.Position + vector(5, 0, -12) }, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')
		character_util.move_waypoint(believer_1, { believer_1.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), believer_1.Position + vector(5, 0, -12) }, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')
		character_util.move_waypoint(believer_2, { believer_2.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), believer_2.Position + vector(5, 0, -12) }, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')
		character_util.move_waypoint(believer_3, { believer_3.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), believer_3.Position + vector(5, 0, -12) }, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(believer_4, { believer_4.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), believer_4.Position + vector(5, 0, -12) }, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')

		character_util.set_active_state(priest_1, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(priest_2, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(believer_1, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(believer_2, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(believer_3, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(believer_4, 'disabled')

		-- custom state 저장
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.safe_house_custom_data_key, 1)

		self.is_moved_safe_house = true
	else

local local_class = newclass("LilithTowerDieHardController")

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = LilithTowerDieHard @
		Comment = 리리스 타워 다이하드 이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 공용 npc
	self.get_maclaine = function() return get_character('diehard_maclaine') end
	self.get_wife = function() return get_character('diehard_wife') end

	-- stage3 전용 npc
	self.get_terrorist = function(num) return get_character('diehard_terrorist_' .. num) end

	-- stage2 전용 marker
	self.get_safe_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('diehard_safe_house_' .. num) end

	-- stage3 전용 marker
	self.get_terrorist_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('terrorist_pos_'.. num) end

	-- stage3 전용 zone
	self.terrorist_zone_name = 'diehard_terrorist_zone'

	self.follower_id = 61

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1

	self.stage2_name = 'lilithtower_1_2'
	self.stage3_name = 'lilithtower_1_3'

	self.bullet_move_dur = 0.15

	self.pooled_bullet_size = 6
	self.bullets_moving = false
	self.moving_bullet_infos = {}
	self.get_custom_sprite = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite') end

	self.active_quest = true

	self.show_diehard = false

	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

-- launch를 이 컨트롤러에서 컨트롤 할 것인가. true로 변경하면 컨트롤 가능
function local_class:need_on_launch()
	return false
end

-- need_on_lunch가 true일 경우 이리로 들어옴
function local_class:on_launch(start_point_name)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if self.active_quest then
		self.active_quest = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_setting, self, e.Fade))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if not self.active_quest then
		self.active_quest = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_setting, self, e.Fade))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil  and self.quest_progress.IsComplete == false
			and stage.Name == self.stage2_name then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 or
				self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
			local wife = self.get_wife()
			character_util.set_direction(wife, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(wife, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.shake(wife, 0.02, 9999)
			character_util.set_position(wife, wife.Position + vector(0.5,-0.7,-0.3))
			character_util.add_listener(wife, self.cs_controller)
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(wife, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end
	elseif self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete == false
			and stage.Name == self.stage3_name then
		local maclaine = self.get_maclaine()
		maclaine.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'ak')


		character_util.set_active_state(maclaine, 'disabled')

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(i)
			character_util.set_active_state(terrorist, 'disabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(terrorist, 0, 0)
		end
	elseif self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self:setting_safe_house()
	end
end

-- main section 설정

	}

function local_class:load_progress()

end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and
			self.quest_progress.IsComplete == false and stage.Name == self.stage3_name then
		quest_util.load_pool_resource('custom_sprite', 'FX_hit', 'FX_lasthit')

		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

		local custom_atlas

		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
					custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
					custom_atlas:Initialize()
				end)

		self.pooled_bullet = {}
		for i = 1, self.pooled_bullet_size do
			self.pooled_bullet[i] = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
			local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
			bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
			bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
			bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6
			bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
			bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas

			bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_small.png'
			bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
		end
	end
end
-- late_update_frame 사용 여부. true로 변경하면 사용가능

	return false
end

	return CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent

end

-- npc exclusive 처리
function local_class:exclusive_setting(fade)
	if stage.Name == self.stage2_name then
		if not self.active_quest then
			local wife = self.get_wife()
			local maclaine = self.get_maclaine()
			if not fade then
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(wife, 0, 0.5)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(maclaine, 0, 0.5)
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
			end
			character_util.set_active_state(wife, 'disabled')
			character_util.set_active_state(maclaine, 'disabled')
		else
			local wife = self.get_wife()
			local maclaine = self.get_maclaine()
			character_util.set_active_state(wife, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_active_state(maclaine, 'enabled')

			if not fade then
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(wife, 1, 0.5)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(maclaine, 1, 0.5)
			end
		end
	elseif self.show_diehard then
		if not self.active_quest then
			local maclaine = self.get_maclaine()
			local terrorist_2 = self.get_terrorist(2)
			local terrorist_3 = self.get_terrorist(3)

			if not fade then
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(maclaine, 0, 0.5)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(terrorist_2, 0, 0.5)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(terrorist_3, 0, 0.5)
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
			end

			character_util.set_active_state(maclaine, 'disabled')
			character_util.set_active_state(terrorist_2, 'disabled')
			character_util.set_active_state(terrorist_3, 'disabled')
		else
			local maclaine = self.get_maclaine()
			local terrorist_2 = self.get_terrorist(2)
			local terrorist_3 = self.get_terrorist(3)

			character_util.set_active_state(maclaine, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_active_state(terrorist_2, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_active_state(terrorist_3, 'enabled')

			if not fade then
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(maclaine, 1, 0.5)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(terrorist_2, 1, 0.5)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(terrorist_3, 1, 0.5)
			else
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(maclaine, 1, 0)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(terrorist_2, 1, 0)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(terrorist_3, 1, 0)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:meet_maclaine()

	local terrorist_2 = self.get_terrorist(2)
	local terrorist_3 = self.get_terrorist(3)
	local maclaine = self.get_maclaine()

	local pos_3 = self.get_terrorist_marker(3).position

	self.show_diehard = true

	character_util.set_active_state(maclaine, 'enabled')

	camera_util.move_async(pos_3, 1.5)
	terrorist_3.Position = pos_3 + vector(0,10,0)

	--region 자유낙하
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	local fall_duration = 1

	local start_pos = terrorist_3.Position

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, terrorist_3.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(terrorist_3, start_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	character_util.set_position(terrorist_3, pos_3)
	--endregion

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	local paper_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = pos_3, target = pos_3 - vector(0.3,0,0)
			, skip_text = true, itemid = 20022, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
	paper_item:SetSortingLayer(true)

	-- 테러리스트들 시체를 보고 (scared, embarrassed jump 1회)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(terrorist_1, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(terrorist_2, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(terrorist_1)
	character_util.normal_jump(terrorist_2)
	character_util.set_anim(terrorist_1, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_anim(terrorist_2, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	-- 으악! 저… 저게 뭐야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(terrorist_1,
			{ key = 'lilithtower_diehard_0', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	character_util.remove_anim(terrorist_1)
	character_util.remove_anim(terrorist_2)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 테러리스트 2, 시체 앞으로 이동
	character_util.move_to_async(terrorist_2, terrorist_3.Position - vector(1,0,0),
			nil, 3, true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(terrorist_2, 'right')

	-- 테러리스트 1 [shout] : 토… 토니잖아! 어떤 녀석이…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(terrorist_2,
			{ key = 'lilithtower_diehard_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- eat 상태로 쪽지 아이템 획득.
	local equip_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(terrorist_2, { name = 'eat', count = 3 })
	equip_sfx:FadeOut(0)

	paper_item.Position = terrorist_2.Position + vector(0.2,0.5,0)
	paper_item:SetSortingLayer(false)

	--테러리스트 2, push 모션으로 쪽지 아이템을 꺼내서 읽음.
	character_util.set_emotion(terrorist_2, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(terrorist_2, { name = 'push', loop = false })

	--테러리스트 2 : ‘이제 나도 자동 소총이 있다 호- 호- 호-’…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(terrorist_2, { key = 'lilithtower_diehard_2', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.show_emoticon(terrorist_2, nil, 'question')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--플로어 오른쪽의 창문을 깨고 들어오는 션 맥클레인
	character_util.set_position(maclaine, terrorist_1.Position + vector(12,2, 0))

	--션 맥클레인, (attack, gauntlet_kick2) 상태로 창문을 깨고 등장, 창 앞에 서있던 테러리스트 1을 발로 차서 airspin으로 날림.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(maclaine,
			{ name = 'gauntlet_kick2', loop = false}, { name = 'attack' })

	local move_end = false

	local window_break = function()
		local progress = {
			start = 1,
			window = 2,
			progress_end = 3
		}
		local cur_progress = 1

		while true do
			if maclaine.Position.x < 55.5 and cur_progress == progress.start then
				cur_progress = progress.window
			elseif maclaine.Position.x < 52.5 and cur_progress == progress.window then
				cur_progress = progress.progress_end
				time_util.mod('attack_mac', 0.25)
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_window_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_sean_01')
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_windowbreak'):Instantiate(maclaine.Position +
						vector(-0.5,0,0.5))
			elseif move_end then
				return
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(window_break))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit'):Instantiate(terrorist_1.Position + vector(0.3,0.4,0))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_01')
	character_util.set_anim(maclaine, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })

	local air_spin_state = CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState.Create(terrorist_1,

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist_2,
			{ name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	time_util.unmod('attack_mac')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.look_at(maclaine, terrorist_2)

	-- 션 맥클레인, rifle_shoot2 자세로 총을 난사하여 남은 테러리스트 쓰러트림.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bullet_routine, self))

	local bullet_start_pos = maclaine.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
			+ vector(-0.8, 0.42, 0) + maclaine.Position

	for i = 1, 6 do
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.15)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end

	wait_for_sec(self.bullet_move_dur + 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist_2,

	-- 이피-카이-예이, 빌어먹을 놈들아!

-- 맥클레인 인터렉트 시

-- 세이프 하우스에 도착한 npc 갱신 함수
function local_class:setting_safe_house(state)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage2_name or self.quest_progress == nil then return end
	local maclaine = self.get_maclaine()
	local wife = self.get_wife()
	local marker_pos_1 = self.get_safe_marker(1).position
	local marker_pos_2 = self.get_safe_marker(2).position + vector(0.2,0,0)

	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		character_util.set_position(maclaine, marker_pos_1)
		character_util.set_position(wife, marker_pos_2)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(maclaine, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(wife, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
		maclaine.Interactable.Talk = 'lilithtower_diehard_28'
		wife.Interactable.Talk = 'lilithtower_diehard_29'
		return
	end

	local progress = lua_helper.get_or_default(state, -1)
	if progress == -1 then
		progress = self.quest_progress.InnerProgress
	end

	if progress == 1 then
		-- 맥클레인만 구출 시
		character_util.set_direction(maclaine, 'left')
		character_util.set_position(maclaine, marker_pos_1)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(maclaine, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		maclaine.Interactable.Talk = 'lilithtower_diehard_15'
		maclaine.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_beep_01'
	elseif progress == 2 then
		-- 와이프만 구출 시
		character_util.set_direction(wife, 'left')
		character_util.set_position(wife, marker_pos_2)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(wife, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'tired' })
		wife.Interactable.Talk = 'lilithtower_diehard_21'
	elseif progress == 3 then
		--둘 다 구출
		maclaine.Interactable.TalkSfx = nil
		character_util.set_position(maclaine, marker_pos_1)
		character_util.set_position(wife, marker_pos_2)
		character_util.set_direction(maclaine, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(wife, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(maclaine, { name = 'push' }, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(wife, { name = 'push' }, { name = 'cry' })
	end
end

-- return 값 만큼 section 이동
function local_class:update_safe_house(npc)
	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(npc, self.get_maclaine()) then
			-- 맥클레인
			return 1
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(npc, self.get_wife()) then
			-- 와이프
			return 2
		end
	elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
		-- 와이프
		return 2
	elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then
		-- 맥클레인
		return 1
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_bullet(start_pos, target_pos, bullet)
	local shoot_dir = (target_pos - start_pos).normalized
	bullet.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)
			* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet.transform.position = start_pos
	table.insert(self.moving_bullet_infos, {
		transform = bullet.transform,
		start_pos = start_pos,
		target_pos = target_pos,
		time_passed = 0,
	})
end

function local_class:bullet_routine()
	self.bullets_moving = true
	while self.bullets_moving do
		local done_index_list = {}
		for index, info in pairs(self.moving_bullet_infos) do
			local progress = info.time_passed / self.bullet_move_dur
			info.transform.position = info.start_pos * (1 - progress) + info.target_pos * progress

			self.moving_bullet_infos[index].time_passed = info.time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if self.moving_bullet_infos[index].time_passed > self.bullet_move_dur then
				local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(2)
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(terrorist)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(terrorist)
				character_util.remove_anim(terrorist)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_hit_01')
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist,
						{name = 'damaged'}, { name = 'idle' })

				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(info.transform.position)
				info.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

				table.insert(done_index_list, index)
			end
		end

		for i = #done_index_list, 1, -1 do
			table.remove(self.moving_bullet_infos, i)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet do
			self.pooled_bullet[i]:Dispose()
		end
	end

	local maclaine = self.get_maclaine()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(maclaine, self.cs_controller)
	local wife = self.get_wife()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(wife, self.cs_controller)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil

	self.quest_id = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.sections = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:bad_ending(section_end)

	local grandmother = self.get_grandmother()
	local option_check = false
	local zone_leave_handler = {
		subscribe_func = function(_, e)
			if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'teatime_last_zone') then
				option_check = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end

	message_system:Subscribe(zone_leave_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'subscribe_func')

	while not option_check and self.end_option do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(zone_leave_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	if not self.end_option then
		return

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_explosion_02')

function local_class:sister_worries_brother()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	if not self.can_play_event then
		return
	end

	self.safe_house_scene_played = true

	-- 내가… 내가.. 손을 놓지 말았어야 했는데..

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kids.crying_sister, { key = 'lilith_tower_life_is_beautiful_2', skip = true })
	-- 네 탓이 아니야… 네 탓이 아니야…!!
	character_util.set_emotion(self.kids.comforting_sister, { name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kids.comforting_sister, { key = 'lilith_tower_life_is_beautiful_3', skip = true })
	-- 분명 둘 다 무사할거야…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kids.comforting_sister, { key = 'lilith_tower_life_is_beautiful_4', skip = true })
	-- 우리처럼 둘 다 숨어있을거라고…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kids.comforting_sister, { key = 'lilith_tower_life_is_beautiful_5', skip = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.kids.comforting_sister, { name = 'tired' })
	-- …벨레누스 님…! 제발 두 사람을 무사하게 해주세요..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kids.crying_sister, { key = 'lilith_tower_life_is_beautiful_6', skip = true })
	-- 다시는 동생을 놀리지 않을게요. 착한 누나가 될게요..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kids.crying_sister, { key = 'lilith_tower_life_is_beautiful_7', skip = true })


	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.kids.crying_sister, self)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.kids.comforting_sister, self)

	-- 내가… 내가.. 손을 놓지 말았어야 했는데..
	self.kids.crying_sister.Interactable.Talk = 'lilith_tower_life_is_beautiful_1'
	self.kids.crying_sister.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_female_cry_02'

	self.kids.comforting_sister.Interactable.Talk = 'lilith_tower_life_is_beautiful_4'

function local_class:exclusive_routine(toggle, fade)
	-- FIXED : [PS-9855] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1
	local request_id = self.current_request_id
	local state = toggle == true and 'disabled' or 'enabled'

	if fade then
		self:toggle_activate_state(state)
	else
		local alpha_to = toggle == true and 0 or 1

		if toggle then
			self:toggle_alpha_fade(alpha_to, request_id)
			-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
			if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
				return
			end
			self:toggle_activate_state(state)
		else
			self:toggle_activate_state(state, request_id)
			-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
			if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
				return
			end
			self:toggle_alpha_fade(alpha_to)
		end
	end

	-- cry 이모션이 지워지지 않아 따로 이모션 해제를 해야함
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			if toggle then
				character_util.remove_emotion(self.kids.crying_sister)
				character_util.remove_emotion(self.kids.comforting_sister)
			else
				character_util.set_emotion(self.kids.crying_sister, { name = 'cry' })
				character_util.set_emotion(self.kids.comforting_sister, { name = 'cry' })
			end
		else
			if toggle then
				character_util.remove_emotion(self.kids.crying_sister)
			else
				character_util.set_emotion(self.kids.crying_sister, { name = 'cry' })
			end

			-- 쓰레기통 상호작용 가능 여부 조작
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
				if toggle then
					self.get_trash_can().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
				else
					self.get_trash_can().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:toggle_alpha_fade(alpha, request_id)
	for _, v in pairs(self.kids) do
		local continue = false
		-- 섹션 2에서 남동생은 이미 투명한 상태이기 때문에 1로 알파값을 변환 시기키 않는다.
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			if v == self.kids.boy and alpha == 1 then
				continue = true
			end
		end
		if not continue then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(v, alpha, 1)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.terrorists) do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.terrorists[i], alpha, 1)
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	-- 1초가 지나거나 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 종료
	while request_id == self.current_request_id and time_passed < 1 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:toggle_activate_state(state)
	for _, v in pairs(self.kids) do
		character_util.set_active_state(v, state)
	end

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.terrorists) do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.terrorists[i], state)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

		-- 스테이지 2에서 레버가 이미 당겨진 상태
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 7 then
			local lever = get_field_object('cctv_room_lever')

			local animator = lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			animator:Play('pull')
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_name_3 then
		-- 스테이지 3에서 샹들리에 파괴 이후에 비활성화시킬 테러리스트 설정

			for i = 1, self.stage_3_deactivate_super_terrorist_num do
				character_util.set_active_state(
						get_character(self.stage_3_deactivate_super_terrorist_name..i), 'disabled')
			end
		end

		-- 스테이지 3 틴트 설정
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 9 then
			field:Tint(self.stage_3_tint_key, unity_color({0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1}), 0)
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_name_4 then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 12 then
			-- 바리케이드 필드오브젝트 설정
			for i = 1, self.stage_4_player_pushable_obj_num do
				stage_util.set_fo_active_state(
						self.stage_4_player_pushable_obj_name..i, 'disabled')
			end

				stage_util.set_fo_active_state(
						self.stage_4_npc_pushable_obj_name..i, 'disabled')
			end
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 11 then
			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(
					self.stage_4_player_pushable_obj_name..1, 'disabled')
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 12 then
			for i = 1, self.stage_4_barricade_particle_obj_num do
				stage_util.set_fo_active_state(
						self.stage_4_barricade_particle_obj_name..i, 'disabled')
			end
		end

			for i = 1, self.stage_4_reset_switch_num do
				stage_util.set_fo_active_state(

			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(
					self.stage_4_barricade_particle_obj_entrance_name..i, 'disabled')
		end

		if quest ~= nil and quest.IsComplete then

		end
	end

	local shutter_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	local animator_list = create_generic_list(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)

	for i = 1, num do
		local cur_shutter = get_field_object(name..i)

		shutter_list:Add(cur_shutter)

	self.medicine_box_item_spec_name = 'drug_basket_normal'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_nurse = function() return get_character('safe_house_nurse') end
	self.get_terrorist = function(num) return get_character('medicine_terrorist_' .. num) end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_medicine_box = function() return get_field_object('medicine_box') end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_reset_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('medicine_box_reset') end
	self.get_medicine_box_position_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('medicine_box_position') end

	-- 이펙트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece_effect_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character') end
	self.get_bullet_proj_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_virus_bullet_proj_groundhit') end

	-- 아이템
	self.medicine_box_item = nil

	-- 이펙트
	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	self.res_holder = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil
	self.pooled_bullet = nil

	-- Exclusive
	self.is_exclusive = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.medicine_box_item then
		self.medicine_box_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.medicine_box_item = nil
	end

	if self.star_piece_effect then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.custom_atlas = nil

	if self.pooled_bullet then
		self.pooled_bullet:Dispose()
		self.pooled_bullet = nil
	end

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent), 'on_event')

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(i)
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'sleep' })
		character_util.set_emotion(terrorist, { name = 'sleep' })
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(terrorist, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'LilithTowerMedicineSection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'LilithTowerMedicineSection2'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'LilithTowerMedicineSection3')
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	self.get_star_piece_effect_pool()
	self.get_bullet_proj_pool()

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
			self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
			self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
		end)
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local consume = false

	if not self.is_exclusive then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent) then
			consume = self:on_got_crashed_event(e)
		end
	end

	if consume then
		return true
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_got_crashed_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(i)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Crash.other, user_party.Leader) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Crash.self, terrorist) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detect_event, self, terrorist)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	local medicine_box = self.get_medicine_box()
	local marker = self.get_medicine_box_position_marker()
	medicine_box.Position = marker.position

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 2 and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
		local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.medicine_box_item_spec_name).Id
		self.medicine_box_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = marker.position + vector(0, 0.2, -0.2), itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true, skip_text = true })
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		local nurse = self.get_nurse()
		self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect_pool():Instantiate(nurse.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, nurse.Transform)
	end

	self.pooled_bullet = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)

	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'virus_bullet_1.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	self.is_exclusive = true

	return true
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	self.is_exclusive = false

	return true
end
--endregion

function local_class:detect_event(terrorist)
	local origin_direction = terrorist.Direction

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(terrorist, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.look_at(terrorist, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(terrorist)
	character_util.set_emotion(terrorist, { name = 'surprise' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(terrorist, { name = 'mad' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	self:stop_equipping_sfx()
	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, terrorist)
	character_util.jump(user_party.Leader, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'scared' })

	-- 누, 누구냐!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(terrorist, { key = 'lilith_tower_medicine_2_5', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local target_pos = user_party.Leader.Bounds.center
	local sniper_pos = terrorist.Bounds.center
	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_08')

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = sniper_pos

	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - sniper_pos)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local move_distance = (sniper_pos - target_pos).magnitude
	local speed = 12

	local timer = 0
	local duration = move_distance / speed

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(sniper_pos, target_pos, 1 - ((duration - timer) / duration))

		bullet_sprite.transform.position = current_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 피격
	self.get_bullet_proj_pool():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	damage_util.show_damage_number(user_party.Leader, 999999, unity_class.color.red, user_party.Leader.Position)

	user_party.Leader.SpineController:AddColor(user_party.Leader.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 3)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party.Leader,
		direction_util.to_vector3(terrorist.Direction).normalized * 0.3, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party.Leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_side_direction(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })

	wait_for_sec(3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	-- 초기화
	local reset_marker = self.get_reset_marker()

	user_party.Leader.SpineController:RemoveColor(user_party.Leader.Name, 0)
	user_party.Leader.Position = reset_marker.position
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, reset_marker.direction)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	character_util.set_direction(terrorist, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'sleep' })
	character_util.set_emotion(terrorist, { name = 'sleep' })
	terrorist.Direction = origin_direction

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
end

function local_class:play_equipping_sfx()
	self:stop_equipping_sfx()

	self.equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
end

function local_class:stop_equipping_sfx()
	if self.equipping_sfx then
		self.equipping_sfx:Stop()
		self.equipping_sfx = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}
